About Us 
 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. 
 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Lisbon, Portugal 
 About the Department 
 Cloudflare's Network Engineering Team builds and runs the infrastructure that runs our software. The Engineering Team is split into two groups: one handles product development and the other handles operations. Product development covers both new features and functionality and scaling our existing software to meet the challenges of a massively growing customer base. The operations team handles one of the world's largest networks with data centers in 190 cities worldwide and a couple of large specialized data centers for internal needs. 
 About the role 
 Cloudflare operates a large global network spanning hundreds of cities (data centers). You will join a team of talented network automation engineers who are building software solutions to improve network resilience and reduce engineering operational toil. 
 You will work on a range of tools, infrastructure and services - new and existing - with an aim to elegantly and efficiently solve problems and deliver practical, maintainable and scalable solutions. Leverage AI tools and automated assistants to streamline daily workflows. 
 Examples Of Desirable Skills, Knowledge And Experience 
 
 BA/BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience 
 3+ years of proven experience in developing software components for network automation. 
 Understanding of software development principles, design patterns, and various programming languages (like python and golang) 
 Proficient with modern Unix/Linux operating systems/distributions 
 Experience in MySQL, Postgres, Clickhouse (or equivalent SQL language) 
 Experience with CI/CD, containers and/or virtualization 
 Experience with Observability systems like prometheus, grafana (or equivalents) 
 Demonstrated experience working alongside AI assistants or automated tools to augment task execution and project delivery 
 
 Bonus Points: 
 
 Knowledge of Networking engineering, with competencies in Layer 2 and Layer 3 protocols and vendor equipment: Cisco, Juniper, etc. 
 Experience building and maintaining large distributed systems 
 Experience managing internal and/or external customer requirements and expectations 
 
 Compensation 
 Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. 
 
 For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary of €54,000 - €75,000 
 
 Equity 
 This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan. 
 Benefits 
 Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. 
 What Makes Cloudflare Special? 
 We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. 
 Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. 
 Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 
 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT ALEX

Alex is the AI recruiter for hiring great people.

Alex interviews, screens, and schedules every candidate – over voice, video, and text – so talent teams hire more great people, faster, without adding TA headcount. The recruiter stays in control: every shortlist is approved by a human, and every relationship and offer is owned by the customer's team.

We're past 1M+ interviews, integrate with 33+ ATS platforms, and 96% of candidates prefer interviewing with Alex. We're revenue-generating, well-funded, backed by premier investors, and are focused on enterprise customers: selling to VPs of Talent Acquisition, CHROs, and CFOs at large employers who are rethinking how hiring gets done at scale.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Sales earns the first contract. Account Management earns every one after it. You'll partner with a Forward-Deployed Engineer on every account, who owns integrations and configuration, so you can stay focused on value and revenue.

What you'll own

 - Renewals, end to end. Open every renewal 90 to 120 days out, forecast it, make the value case and close it.

 - Expansion. Size the next opportunity inside each account (new teams, new use cases, new regions) and go get it on paper.

 - Executive relationships. Build and keep relationships with VPs of TA, CHROs and exec sponsors, plus the champions and recruiters who use Alex every day.

 - Value in the customer's numbers. Agree success metrics, track them and lead business reviews on outcomes like time to first interview, hires and recruiter capacity returned.

 - Adoption and change management. Help champions sell AI-led hiring inside their own organization.

 - The voice of your book. Bring patterns from your book back to product and engineering.

What you can expect

Month 1: Learn & Earn Trust

 - Know every account in your book: contract terms, renewal dates, champions, exec sponsors, success metrics and open risks.

 - Meet every champion and exec sponsor in your book and build a renewal forecast for the next two quarters.

 - Run your first renewal conversations

 - Run your first business review using the customer’s own numbers (time to first interview, recruiter capacity returned).

 - Ship one improvement from what you learned

Month 3: Own the Accounts

 - Close your first renewals on time

 - Have at least one expansion opportunity sized, in negotiation or signed (a new team, use case or region)

 - Hold an executive relationship (VP of TA, CHRO or similar) in every strategic account, not just a champion

 - Lead business reviews across your accounts

Month 6: Drive Growth and Build the Playbook

 - Hit your renewal and expansion targets

 - Forecast renewals with confidence and own a predictable expansion pipeline

 - Have built something nobody handed you: an AI-led change management playbook, a segment strategy, or a repeatable expansion motion that others on the team now use

 - Be the person a CHRO calls when they need to explain AI-led hiring to their own board

ABOUT YOU

 - 4+ years in a quota-carrying post-sale role (Account Manager, Account Executive or similar) with a renewal or expansion number you can name

 - Experience managing enterprise accounts: long procurement cycles, buying committees, multi-year contracts

 - A track record of relationships at the VP and C-suite level

 - Evidence you have sized and closed expansion, not just kept customers happy

 - Clear, simple communication and strong commercial negotiation skills

 - You've built something with AI yourself (a workflow, an agent, an automation) and can explain to a CHRO what AI transformation actually takes

 - You've helped a customer's organization adopt a new way of working, not just switched on a tool

 - You've built something from 0 to 1, like a playbook, a segment or a process nobody handed you. You move fast and act before you're asked

 - You turn escalations into stronger relationships and work closely with engineering and sales to get customers what they need

 - You want direct feedback and change course quickly when you get it

Bonus

 - You have worked in talent acquisition or recruiting yourself

 - You have sold or managed HR tech, ATS or HRIS products

 - You have closed new business as an AE

 - You have experience at a high growth start-up

This might not be the role for you if you prefer a support role without a number attached, or you don't want to work in person. We're in office in SF 5 days a week.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

 - Shape the foundation of our Account Management org

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - FSA, DCFSA, HSA options

 - Flexible paid time off (PTO)

 - 401(k) plan

 - Fully paid parental leave program

 - Commuter benefits

 - In office lunch

 - Dog-friendly office

WHAT AM I WAITING FOR?

If you’ve gotten this far and building from zero-to-one excites you, we want you to apply. Your first conversation will be with Alex, our AI recruiter.

Alex is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Manager, PLG & Agent-led Growth
jobs.description:
Manager, PLG & Agent-led Growth People no longer have to learn complex systems anymore. They ask Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and then let them set it up for them. Supabase says over 60% of its new databases are launched by AI tools, and agent-created databases at Neon are at 80%. 
 SingleStore is still built for a person clicking through our portal. AI & Agents do not reach for us often enough, and when they do, they struggle to sign up, load data, and get to a working query without a human. That is the problem this role exists to solve. 
 You will own product-led growth and agent-led growth at SingleStore. That means making SingleStore the database that AI answer engines recommend, that agents pick, and that agents and people can get running on their own data in minutes. You will also turn that usage into revenue through data & product-led sales. 
 You will report to our VP of Growth, work closely with our Chief Marketing Officer and product team, and have visibility into the CEO. On the growth team, you will partner with our Senior GTM Engineer, Lifecycle Ops, and marketing team members. 
 Role and responsibilities: Own agent-led growth end to end: agent preference (agents know, trust, and pick SingleStore) and agent experience (an agent can sign up, set up, load data, and reach a working query without our UI).Own answer engine optimization (AEO) strategy so ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity name and cite SingleStore correctly, and turn those findings into content, docs, and product work. Drive AI-assisted onboarding with product to ensure users have the option Write PRDs and work with Product, Engineering, Design, and Docs on the work that makes us agent-ready: our MCP server and its listings, connectors and integrations with AI app builders, and docs an agent can follow. Improve the journey from web to sign up to self-serve revenue Run product-led sales with our SEs and Sales team: use trial and on-demand usage signals to start conversations that deliver value, like a tuned query, and turn them into pipeline and revenue. Create or direct technical content that drives AEO and agent preference, such as sample apps on GitHub, technical videos, and database comparisons, with our content team. Help drive product marketing positioning across marketing campaigns Define hypotheses, run experiments, and report on the growth metrics that matter: MQLs, active users, agent-created orgs, AI share of voice, and new logo pipeline. What success looks like in your first 90 days SingleStore's mention and citation rate in AI answers is up across our tracked prompts, with correct positioning. SingleStore is listed where agents look for tools, including the official MCP registry and AI connector directories. Agents complete most steps of a headless SingleStore setup, locally and in the cloud, and we can report agent-created orgs as their own segment. 
 Position requirements: 5+ years in product management or product marketing, growth, or technical growth roles, with at least 2 years in product-led growth or self-serve B2B software Hands-on with AI agents and coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and MCP. You build prototypes yourself, even if you vibe code them A track record of shipping onboarding, acquisition, or monetization experiments with measurable results Proficient with AI tooling Strong analytical skills, comfortable with data analysis and product analytics tools like Mixpanel Able to write clearly and lead R&D Understands how developers evaluate infrastructure, and how SEO, AEO, and technical content influence that evaluation Excellent communication skills, able to work across Product, Marketing, and Sales and synthesize insights for executives Comfortable in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where curiosity and a bias for action are valued Flexible schedule, as teammates work across PST, CST, EST, GMT, and WET time zones Nice to have: experience at a database, data infrastructure, or developer tools company, or with product-led sales 
 About us: 
 SingleStore delivers the cloud-native database with the speed and scale to power the world’s data-intensive applications. With a distributed SQL database that introduces simplicity to your data architecture by unifying transactions and analytics, SingleStore empowers digital leaders to deliver exceptional, real-time data experiences to their customers. SingleStore is venture-backed and headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Sunnyvale, Raleigh, Seattle, Boston, London, Lisbon, Bangalore, Dublin and Kyiv. 
 Consistent with our commitment to diversity & inclusion, we value individuals with the ability to work on diverse teams and with a diverse range of people. 
 To all recruitment agencies: SingleStore does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to SingleStore employees. SingleStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company. 
 SingleStore is the real-time database for AI, apps, and analytics. Teams use it to transact, analyze, and search their data in one place, in real time, so their applications and AI agents act on fresh data at scale. Customers worldwide, including Fortune 500 companies, run real-time AI applications and analytics on SingleStore. We are headquartered in San Francisco, with teams across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. 
 We are committed to diversity and inclusion, and we value people who do their best work on diverse teams and with a diverse range of people.

 Remote: UK, Europe, or USA

jobs.description:
Material Handler | Nox Metals | Detroit, MI

 

About Nox Metals. American factories deserve a supply chain that moves as fast as they do. Nox Metals is building it, along with the tools that run it. We’re a technology company in Metro Detroit supplying aluminum plate, bar, and rounds to aerospace and defense manufacturers. We use software and automation to supply metal to American factories faster than the industry thought possible.

 

The role. We're hiring Material Handlers to keep metal flowing through our Detroit factory, from the truck to the saw to the customer. Nothing gets cut until it gets moved. You will receive, move, stage, and ship aluminum plate, bar, and rounds. You run forklifts, load and unload trucks, and make sure every piece of material is where our system says it is.

This is the way onto our floor. We'll train and certify you on forklifts and cranes, and as you grow you'll learn the bandsaw and the rest of our equipment. You report to your Shift Lead.

If you've worked in a warehouse, on a loading dock, or in a factory and you want to learn a trade, this is your next step.

 

Shift hours:

Weekdays, First Shift: Monday through Thursday, 7:00 AM to 5:30 PM

Weekdays, Second Shift: Monday through Thursday, 5:30 PM to 4:00 AM

Weekends, First Shift: Friday through Sunday, 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM

Weekends, Second Shift: Friday through Sunday, 7:00 PM to 7:00 AM

 

You will:

· Follow all OSHA and site safety protocols and hold your teammates to the same standard

· Operate forklifts to receive, stage, and move aluminum plate, bar, and rounds, we’ll train and certify you

· Load and unload trucks safely and efficiently

· Receive inbound material and verify against purchase orders

· Package, label, and stage outbound shipments

· Record material movements in our software systems, accurately, every time

· Keep the floor clean, organized, and free of hazards

· Complete required safety training and certifications

· Learn the bandsaw and other metals equipment as you grow in the role

· Complete other tasks as assigned

 

You are:

· Committed to safety

· Experienced with forklifts or warehouse work, or a fast learner ready to get certified

· Attentive to detail, every load, every label, every shipment

· Coachable and curious about broader floor operations

· A team player with a good attitude

· Someone who takes ownership, if it is your shift, it is your responsibility

· Reliable and steady under pressure

· Comfortable with software, or willing to learn

· Organized and dependable

· Able to lift up to 50 lbs., operate heavy equipment and be on your feet for a full shift with or without reasonable accommodation

· Not afraid to work outside normal hours when America demands it

 

Nice to have:

· Experience in a manufacturing, warehouse, or industrial environment

· Forklift and/or overhead crane certification

· Experience with bandsaws, industrial saws, or metals handling

· Comfortable using AI tools to work faster and smarter

 

Benefits:

· Equity in Nox Metals

· Company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance

 

This role is full time, in person in Detroit.

 

Nox Metals is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based on skill, attitude, and fit for the work, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, height, weight, marital status, or any other protected status under federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Recruiter
jobs.description:
About Nox Metals. American factories deserve a supply chain that moves as fast as they do. Nox Metals is building it, along with the tools that run it. We’re a technology company in Metro Detroit supplying aluminum plate, bar, and rounds to aerospace and defense manufacturers. We use software and automation to supply metal to American factories faster than the industry thought possible.

The role. We’re hiring a Recruiter to keep our factories staffed. Nox is growing fast on the floor and in the office, and every empty seat slows us down.

Most of your day is on the phone. Nox is an AI-forward company, and you’ll use AI tools to work through a high volume of candidates 10x faster than the average recruiter. You also go find the people who aren’t applying, run short phone screens, and put the strongest candidates straight in front of their future manager. You’ll recruit for the floor and the office, and as Nox opens new plants, including one in Los Angeles, you’ll help staff each one.

If you’ve spent a few years in in-house recruiting, can get a clear read on someone in 15 minutes, and want to help build how a fast-growing company hires, this is your role.

Shift hours:
Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, with some early or late hours to reach second shift and weekend candidates as needed.

You will:

 - Review inbound applications daily and identify the candidates worth calling

 - Use AI tools throughout your day to move faster on sourcing, outreach, scheduling, and candidate communication

 - Source candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, and our partner network

 - Run outbound: find people who aren’t looking and give them a reason to talk to us

 - Run quick phone screens and decide who moves forward

 - Move qualified candidates through each step of our hiring process, coordinating interviews with hiring managers and keeping every candidate informed so no good candidate sits waiting on us

 - Develop and maintain relationships with outside partners like colleges, trade schools, and city workforce programs that send us good people year after year

 - Write job postings the right people want to apply to, and keep them live and current

 - Keep candidate records clean in our ATS, and track which sources produce our best hires

 - Follow every People Ops SOP, and tell us when one is broken so we can fix it

 - Handle confidential information with discretion, every time

You are:

 - 3 to 5 years in in-house recruiting, with high-volume phone screening and real outbound experience

 - Already using AI tools in your daily work, and looking for ways to use them more

 - Fast and decisive on the phone: you get a clear read quickly and can explain exactly why you said yes or no

 - A clear, direct communicator with candidates from the shop floor to the front office

Pay and benefits:

jobs.title: Customer Success, EMEA
jobs.description:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

THE ROLE

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM) at Mistral, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of enterprise customers, ensuring they achieve their goals using Mistral’s solutions. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, driving adoption, satisfaction, and long-term success. 

This role is ideal for those who excel in customer-facing environments, enjoy solving complex challenges, and are passionate about turning customer success into business impact.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

CUSTOMER SUCCESS OWNERSHIP

 - Manage a portfolio of enterprise customers, ensuring they maximize the value of Mistral’s AI solutions.

 - Build strong, trusted relationships with key stakeholders, understanding their business objectives and tailoring solutions to meet their needs.

 - Lead customer onboarding, adoption, and ongoing engagement to drive product usage and satisfaction.

 - Monitor customer health metrics, identify risks, and proactively address challenges to prevent churn.

 - Collaborate with Sales to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities based on customer needs and usage patterns.

 - Partner with Product and Engineering teams to gather customer feedback and influence the product roadmap.

 - Develop and deliver customer training, enablement programs, and best practices to drive adoption.

 - Conduct regular business reviews (QBRs) to align on goals, challenges, and success metrics.

STRATEGIC CUSTOMER GUIDANCE

 - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, guiding them on how to leverage Mistral’s AI solutions to achieve their business outcomes.

 - Work closely with Support and Product teams to ensure seamless customer experiences, from deployment to production.

 - Create and execute customer success plans with clear KPIs, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

 - Advocate for customer needs internally, ensuring their voice is heard in product and strategic discussions.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

 - Share customer insights with Product, Sales, and Engineering teams to inform product improvements and strategic initiatives.

 - Clear obstacles for customers during deployment and adoption phases, accelerating time-to-value.

 - Support renewal processes, including contract negotiations, expansion discussions, and coordination with internal teams.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles, such as Customer Success, Account Management, or Solutions Consulting, ideally in a technical or SaaS environment.

 - Proven ability to manage enterprise customer relationships, with a focus on driving adoption, satisfaction, and retention.

 - Experience working with technical products, with the ability to engage confidently with Data, IT, and Engineering teams.

 - Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to tailor messaging for technical and executive audiences.

 - Business acumen: Ability to identify upsell and expansion opportunities while ensuring customer success.

 - Technical aptitude: Familiarity with AI/ML concepts is a plus; ability to understand and discuss technical requirements is essential.

 - Hands-on, customer-centric, collaborative, and organized, with a passion for solving complex challenges.

WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link.

PRIVACY POLICY

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

jobs.title: Sr. Compliance Associate Lead - Market Surveillance
jobs.description:
BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken's Market Surveillance function is responsible for detecting, investigating and reporting market abuse across our regulated trading venues, spanning spot crypto markets, crypto futures, tokenised equities, OTC markets and consumer trading. As our licensing footprint and product range grow, so does the scale and complexity of the surveillance programme behind them.

We are hiring a Senior Compliance Associate Lead to take on our more complex casework, own an area of the surveillance programme, and act as a senior point of reference for the analysts around them.

THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Take the more complex investigations end to end, including those that begin as a referral rather than an alert, and present conclusions to senior compliance stakeholders and the business.

 - Act as a senior reviewer for colleagues' work, and a point of escalation for judgement calls on how an alert or a case should be treated.

 - Contribute to threshold and model reviews, recalibrating detection as trading behaviour, products and market structure change.

Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. Company: KB Behavioral Health, a Finni Health company
Job Type: Part-time
Location: In-person – Nashville, TN
Pay: $24.00 – $26.00 per hour

About the Role

KB Behavioral Health, a Finni Health company, is seeking a dedicated and compassionate Behavior Technician (BT/RBT) to join our team in Nashville, TN. In this role, you will work one-on-one with children in their homes, using Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy techniques under the supervision of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) to make a meaningful impact on their development and daily life.

Schedule

 - Monday-Friday, 3:30pm-7:00pm. Saturday as needed

What You'll Do

 - Deliver in-person ABA therapy in a child's home

 - Follow behavior intervention plans designed by a BCBA

 - Collect and record data on client progress and behaviors

 - Participate in supervision sessions with a BCBA

 - Attend required team meetings and training sessions

What We Offer

 - Competitive hourly pay: $24–$26/hour

 - Training and support to obtain RBT certification

 - Career growth opportunities within the ABA field

 - PTO and sick time (part-time accrual)

 - Mileage reimbursement

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance (for full-time employees)

What You'll Need

 - High school diploma or equivalent

 - Experience working with children

 - Passion for supporting children with special needs

 - Reliable transportation

 - Active CPR certification (Required)

 - RBT certification (Preferred) or willingness to obtain it within a set timeframe

Physical Requirements

 - Ability to lift up to 50 pounds

 - Ability to kneel, squat, crawl, sit, and stand for extended periods

 - Comfortable engaging in play and physical activity with children

About Us – KB Behavioral Health, a Finni Health Company

KB Behavioral Health partners with Finni Health to provide compassionate, in-home ABA therapy. Finni Health supports local BCBAs and technicians with tools, training, and operational excellence to deliver high-quality care to families in their communities. Together, we are redefining how autism care is delivered—one child at a time.

Application Questions

 - Are you located within a 45-minute commute of Nashville, TN?

 - Are you available to work [Schedule]?

License/Certification

 - RBT Certification (Preferred)

Must be at least 18 years of age

Background Check

All candidates must pass a background check. Employment offers are contingent upon successful screening results to ensure the safety of the children and families we serve.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
WHERE DECODA IS HEADED

Our mission is to add healthy years to people's lives, starting with elective care.

We're building the software powering the clinics at the forefront of aesthetics, wellness and longevity. As Decoda grows, so does the opportunity to shape how this industry thinks, operates and evolves.

Marketing will be central to that. We need to turn what we're building into a brand people recognize, trust and want to follow, one that gives Decoda a distinct point of view and makes us a defining voice in the industry. You'll have the opportunity to build that from the ground up.

THE ROLE

You own how the market sees Decoda.

You'll set our brand identity and positioning, then make sure everything we put in front of the market tells the same story. Our ads, our content, our launches and our point of view should all line up behind it.

You'll work closely with leadership and know where the company is headed. You'll turn those goals into a marketing plan, put it into action, and show whether it's working.

You'll also lead the people doing the work. You'll mentor and train our content and creative team, raise the bar on what they make, and help them grow into stronger marketers.

HOW YOU'LL HELP US GET THERE

Own the brand. You'll define Decoda's brand identity and positioning and protect it everywhere we show up. One voice, one look, one clear point of view, from an ad to a conference booth.

Make Decoda the voice of elective care. You'll build our thought leadership on where the industry is headed across longevity, wellness and aesthetics. When something changes, Decoda should be part of the conversation.

Build the strategy. You'll set the marketing plan and tie it straight to company goals. Every campaign should have a reason to exist and a number it's meant to move.

Connect ads and content. Our paid and organic work should work together, not side by side. You'll plan ads, content and messaging as one system so they pull in the same direction.

Make every launch land. We ship products quickly. You'll build the plan that takes each release to market, so clinic owners understand why it matters and want to use it.

Turn customers into our best marketing. You'll build the system for collecting client feedback, testimonials and success stories, and turn them into proof that sells.

Grow the team. You'll mentor and train our more junior marketers, give them clear direction and honest feedback, and build a team that can scale with the company.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - 4 to 7 years in marketing, ideally at a B2B SaaS or high growth startup

 - You've owned brand or positioning yourself, not just carried out someone else's plan

 - You've mentored or managed at least one marketer

 - Experience running paid and organic channels together around launches

 - You have a point of view. You can spot where an industry is going and turn it into a story people want to follow

 - Strong writing. You can sharpen a message and explain why the new version is better

 - Commercial instincts. You connect marketing work to pipeline and revenue, not just engagement

 - You're happy to roll up your sleeves. You'll set the strategy and still write the copy when it matters

 - Experience in healthcare, medical aesthetics, wellness or longevity is a plus, not a requirement

LOGISTICS

This role is based in Toronto and is in person. Some travel for conferences.

jobs.title: Senior Detection Engineer | SecOps
jobs.description:
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You'll own detection engineering and help shape how ARQ detects and responds to threats. From bringing new log sources into ARQ’s SIEM to writing, testing and tuning detections, you'll be responsible for making sure our coverage works when it matters.

We're looking for someone who combines hands-on detection experience with an engineering mindset. You'll work directly with our CISO and a small global security team, with the autonomy to prioritise gaps and build practical solutions. Automation is central to how we work: you'll build and run AI agents that support rule development, validation, alert triage and threat hunting, with you reviewing and approving their output.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own detection engineering end to end in Datadog Cloud SIEM: identify missing log sources, prioritise onboarding and build reliable detection coverage.

 - Write, test and tune detection rules, reducing false positives while keeping meaningful threats visible.

 - Map coverage to MITRE ATT&CK and validate it by reproducing attacker activity.

 - Manage detections as code, using version control, CI pipelines and code review.

 - Build and run automation and AI agents for rule authoring, detection validation, coverage mapping, alert triage and threat hunting.

 - Investigate security incidents, including triage, scoping, evidence collection and clear incident write-ups.

 - Help develop automated response and containment capabilities.

 - Track and communicate detection coverage, validation results and response performance to security leadership.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - 5+ years in security, including 3+ years writing and owning detections in production.

 - Hands-on experience with a cloud SIEM and its query language, such as Datadog Cloud SIEM, Splunk, Elastic, Google SecOps.

 - Deep knowledge of AWS logs, particularly CloudTrail, IAM and IAM Identity Center, alongside experience with SaaS audit logs such as Google Workspace, GitHub, GitLab or Okta.

 - Experience managing detections as code using Terraform, Git, CI pipelines and code review.

 - Practical experience mapping detections to MITRE ATT&CK and testing rules by reproducing attacks with tools such as Atomic Red Team or Stratus Red Team.

 - Python skills for automation, log analysis and security tooling, with a record of shipping automation or AI agents that others use.

 - Hands-on incident response experience, from investigating alerts to documenting findings and remediation.

 - The ability to work independently, prioritise effectively and own outcomes in a small team without a dedicated SOC behind you.

 - Strong written and verbal communication in English.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Familiarity with CrowdStrike Falcon, Datadog SIEM, Cloudflare Zero Trust or WAF.

 - Experience working with Kubernetes (EKS) audit logs.

 - Threat hunting, red team or purple team experience.

 - Experience building agentic workflows using Claude or OpenAI.

 - A background in fintech, payments or crypto, with exposure to SOC 2 or PCI DSS.

 - Spanish or Portuguese language skills.

BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary and benefits

 - Stock options, so you own part of what you build

 - Discretionary performance bonus

 - The latest tools and technology

 - A world-class team that will challenge and grow your skills

 - The opportunity to help build the best fintech app in Latin America

 - Office Policy: 3-4 days a week in-office

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You'll help shape how ARQ manages security governance, risk and compliance across the group. Based in Colombia, you'll work directly with our group CISO and a global security team, owning programmes that support our growth across multiple markets.

We're looking for someone who takes ownership beyond preparing for an audit. You'll turn framework requirements into practical controls, work with engineers to close gaps, and give partners, auditors and regulators a clear picture of how we manage security. You'll also help us automate repetitive work, from evidence collection and questionnaires to vendor reviews.

This is an individual contributor role with broad ownership and a path towards leading GRC as the function grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own and improve security compliance programmes, including SOC 2, PCI DSS readiness and GDPR-related requirements.

 - Coordinate audit preparation and delivery: define scope, work with control owners, maintain evidence and drive findings through to remediation.

 - Own the vendor security due diligence programme, from initial risk assessment and security reviews to ongoing monitoring and reassessment.

 - Lead responses to security questionnaires, partner audits and regulatory requests, working with regional stakeholders and the group security team.

jobs.title: Operations Manager, Product & Engineering (Incident Operations)
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

Reflection is a research lab making intelligence open and accessible for everyone to use, customize, and build on. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Reflection is hiring an experienced, business-minded litigation leader to build and lead our litigation and investigations function. You will serve as the company’s principal legal advisor on disputes and contentious matters, own litigation strategy across a broad portfolio, and establish the systems and processes that prepare Reflection for its next stage of growth.

You will combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution: assessing emerging threats, directing significant matters, advising senior leadership, managing outside counsel, and building practical approaches to litigation readiness, discovery, subpoenas, and investigations. Your remit will include complex technology and intellectual property disputes, commercial matters, and regulatory investigations, with responsibility for coordinating other disputes across the business.

You will work closely with our Head of Product & Regulatory and colleagues across Legal, Research, Engineering, Safety, Security, and the business to anticipate risk and inform decisions about model development, open-weight releases, and commercialization. You will help turn lessons from disputes and investigations into better advice, stronger processes, and informed business decisions.

This is an opportunity to define and operationalize an important legal function at a frontier AI company. You should be equally comfortable recommending a strategy to executives, working through technical facts with researchers, improving a legal brief, and building a process that the company can use repeatedly.

Design and oversee legal-hold, preservation, collection, review, and production processes in partnership with IT, Security, Research, Privacy, and outside specialists.  - Lead regulatory investigations and enforcement responses. Manage investigative inquiries and contested matters in close partnership with Product & Regulatory counsel and other relevant legal colleagues. Develop response strategies, coordinate factual submissions and witness preparation, and assess the implications of proposed resolutions.

 - Advise proactively on product and business risk. Partner with Research, Engineering, Product, and Legal colleagues on material disputes exposure associated with training data, model development and releases, licensing, commercial relationships, and public representations.  - Support sensitive investigations and leadership decisions. Lead or coordinate internal investigations as appropriate, protect confidential information, and provide clear recommendations to the General Counsel and senior leadership on consequential legal, business, and reputational issues.

 - Build effective cross-functional practices. Deliver training and playbooks, coordinate with Communications on sensitive matters, and work with Finance and relevant legal colleagues on litigation reporting, insurance, indemnification, and potential financial exposure.

jobs.description:
WE ARE AN APPLIED AI LAB BUILDING END-TO-END SOFTWARE AGENTS.

We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer. 

Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.

Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us.

About The Role

We are hiring a Recruiting Sourcer to join our EMEA Talent team, based in London. This is an in-office role.

You will own the top of the funnel for hiring across the region, partnering closely with recruiters and hiring managers to find, engage and convert exceptional people who aren't looking for us yet.

You will be expected to operate with urgency, creativity and high judgment. You will not simply run searches. You will build our outbound engine: mapping markets, mining our networks, showing up where great people are and turning cold prospects into engaged candidates.

The ideal person is a curious, resourceful hunter who measures success by pipeline quality, not volume, and knows how to create momentum in ambiguous, fast-moving markets.

What You’ll Do

 - Own outbound sourcing across our EMEA hiring priorities, with a focus on technical roles.

 - Build deep talent maps across enterprise software, AI, developer tools, cloud, infrastructure and high-growth technology companies.

 - Partner with recruiters and hiring managers to calibrate on profiles early, then iterate quickly based on feedback and conversion data.

 - Use the full sourcing toolkit (LinkedIn Recruiter, Juicebox, Boolean and X-ray search, GitHub, communities) and go beyond it with creative strategies that reach people others miss.

 - Run referral mining: work systematically through our team's, investors' and alumni networks to uncover warm paths to top candidates.

jobs.title: AI Scientist - Domain Expert Crashworthiness
jobs.description:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

ABOUT THE JOB

Mistral AI is looking for a Domain Expert in crashworthiness simulations to help build AI-accelerated simulation capabilities for industrial engineering.

You will work at the intersection of industrial simulation, physics modeling, machine learning, and engineering workflows. Your role is to bring deep solid-mechanics expertise into the design, training, evaluation, and deployment of AI Physics Models for real engineering use cases.

This is a hands-on technical role. We are looking for someone who understands industrial structural simulation not only conceptually, but through direct experience with simulation models, solver workflows, data generation, validation, and engineering decision-making.

You will work with research, product, and customer-facing teams to ensure that our models are useful against real engineering standards — not only benchmark metrics.

Relevant application areas may include automotive crashworthiness, aerospace structures, consumer-electronics drop/reliability, manufacturing, durability/fatigue, and other nonlinear structural mechanics problems.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Work with our research team to define, generate, and iteratively improve simulation datasets for training and evaluating crashworthiness foundation models, balancing coverage of relevant physical scenarios, simulation fidelity, and computational cost.

 - Design and run high-fidelity simulation campaigns using structural mechanics solvers such as Abaqus, LS-DYNA, Ansys Mechanical, Radioss or equivalent tools.

 - Define the relevant variation space for training data: geometry, mesh resolution, material behavior, boundary conditions, loading, contact, joints, failure modes, and engineering KPIs.

 - Build or guide automated pipelines for simulation setup, execution, post-processing, dataset creation, and model evaluation.

 - Work with research teams to train and evaluate AI models on simulation data, and diagnose failure modes caused by data gaps, poor coverage, numerical artifacts, or model limitations.

 - Evaluate model outputs against industrial engineering needs, including field-level accuracy, scalar KPIs, deformation modes, load paths, energy absorption, stress/strain fields, failure indicators, uncertainty, and out-of-domain behavior.

 - Work with industrial customers to understand their simulation workflows and engineering priorities, define use cases and success criteria, and incorporate their feedback into model development and validation.
 
 

ABOUT YOU

 - You have deep expertise in crashworthiness, solid mechanics, and structural mechanics, with substantial experience in industrial simulation workflows.

 - You have a Master’s degree or equivalent technical depth in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, civil/structural engineering, computational mechanics, applied physics, or a related field.

 - You have 4+ years of relevant industrial experience (or PhD +1 years) in domains such as automotive, aerospace, and consumer electronics.

 - You have hands-on experience with explicit dynamics for crash or impact simulation and understand nonlinear FEM and related topics such as contact, plasticity, structural dynamics, buckling, material modeling, fracture/damage, fatigue, crashworthiness, or durability.

 - You have direct experience with simulation validation, correlation, model quality, numerical sensitivity, and engineering KPI definition.

 - You are a strong Python developer who can build and maintain reliable tools for simulation automation, data processing, and model evaluation. You apply sound software engineering practices, including version control with Git, automated testing, code review, and clear documentation.

 - You have hands-on experience working in Linux and HPC environments, including submitting and monitoring batch jobs, selecting appropriate compute resources, and troubleshooting simulation workflows. You can run simulation campaigns efficiently across a compute cluster.

 - You are comfortable operating in ambiguous technical environments and turning poorly defined industrial problems into scoped datasets, experiments, metrics, and execution plans.

 - You communicate clearly with both deep technical experts and non-specialist stakeholders.

IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU

 - Have experience applying machine learning, surrogate modeling, reduced-order modeling, optimization, or data-driven methods to simulation problems.

 - Have contributed to reusable internal tools, open-source code, simulation automation frameworks, or production-quality engineering workflows.

 - Have experience working directly with industrial customers, product teams, or engineering decision-makers.

 - Have publications, patents, internal technical leadership, or recognized contributions in engineering, simulation, computational mechanics, or ML-for-physics communities.

WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

 2. Interview with Théo, about your portfolio or past experience (30 min)

 3. Case study and meetings at our Paris office

 4. Reference checks

 5. Offer

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US?

 - Real impact: our agents free hospital teams from administrative work.

 - A role that shapes the product: your work goes straight into the app hospitals use.

 - Competitive compensation: salary and equity (BSPCE).

 - A great place to work: bright offices in Paris, regular team moments and two offsites a year.

 - Full benefits: health insurance, meal vouchers, transport coverage, training and wellbeing budgets.

 
 
 

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.
If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

jobs.title: Head of Deployments
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE:

Kastle is building the AI employee for financial services. We work with some of America's largest banks, helping them scale their operations using autonomous AI Agents that process payments, originate loans, and help customers get a world class experience during some of the biggest financial decisions of their lives.

We've processed over $2 billion in transactions and are backed by Insight Partners and Y Combinator. If you are interested in building AI that is applied in the real world where precision, reliability, and performance matter and redefine access to credit across the world, apply below.

We just raised a $24M Series A and are growing fast!

ABOUT THE ROLE

Kastle is hiring its first Head of Deployments to build the team that takes our AI agents from signed contract to live production inside banks, lenders and mortgage servicers.

Kastle is the AI workforce platform for financial services, starting with consumer lending. Our voice, SMS and workflow agents collect payments, answer borrower questions and qualify loan inquiries, working on top of the systems lenders already run, such as ICE MSP, rather than replacing them. We're a San Francisco team backed by Insight Partners, Y Combinator, Commerce Ventures and Fifth Wall, and we closed a $24M Series A in September 2026.

You'll report to the CEO and own every customer deployment end to end. You'll lead forward deployed engineers, deployment PMs and process specialists who embed with lending operations teams, scope workflows, integrate with core systems and get agents into production safely. As we scale across banks and financial institutions globally, you'll turn bespoke rollouts into a repeatable deployment engine.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and scale the deployments org. Hire, develop and retain forward deployed engineers, deployment PMs and lending process specialists. Set the hiring bar and team structure as we grow from a handful of deployments to dozens running at once.

 - Own delivery for every customer. Be accountable for time-to-live, quality and adoption at each bank, credit union, lender and servicer. Run kickoffs, scoping, integration, UAT and go-live, and step in personally on the hardest accounts.

 - Make deployments repeatable. Turn one-off rollouts into playbooks, reusable integration patterns (servicing cores, LOS, dialers, CRMs) and tooling that cut deployment time with each customer.

 - Get compliance right from day one. Partner with customers' risk, compliance and InfoSec teams on vendor reviews, model risk management and consumer protection rules (TCPA, FDCPA/Reg F, UDAAP) so agents launch safely and audit-ready.

 - Feed the product roadmap. Turn what you learn in the field into clear product requirements. Work closely with Engineering and Product on what becomes platform versus what stays custom.

 - Partner with Sales and Customer Success. Join late-stage deals to scope solutions credibly, define clean handoffs from sale to deployment to ongoing success, and help expand accounts after launch.

 - Bring operational rigor. Define engagement models and deployment pricing, plan capacity for a scarce team, track deployment metrics, and report customer outcomes to leadership and in customer QBRs.
 
 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years in technical, customer-facing roles, with 4+ years leading deployment, solutions engineering, professional services or implementation teams

 - A track record of building a team or service line from early stage and scaling it through rapid growth

 - Hands-on experience deploying enterprise software into regulated environments, ideally banks, lenders, mortgage servicers or other financial institutions

 - Strong technical depth: APIs, system integrations, data pipelines and the SDLC, enough to unblock engineers and earn trust from customer IT teams

 - Working knowledge of LLMs, AI agents or conversational AI, and sound judgment on where they work in production and where they don't

 - Commercial instincts: you've scoped and priced services work and supported complex enterprise sales cycles

 - Clear communicator who can run a room with a bank COO one day and debug an integration with an engineer the next

Nice to have

 - Domain knowledge of consumer lending operations: servicing, collections, loss mitigation or originations

 - Experience with servicing and lending systems such as ICE MSP, Black Knight, Encompass or similar cores

 - Background with voice or contact-center technology

 - Prior early-stage startup experience

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification.

Replit is changing who gets to build software. As an agentic software creation platform, Replit lets anyone, from individual creators to teams inside the world’s largest companies, turn natural language into applications, internal tools, dashboards, and websites that solve real problems.

We are looking for a Head of Corporate Affairs - Strategy & Growth to help lead Replit’s next chapter of enterprise expansion, strategic relationship building, and institutional engagement.

This is a senior, commercially minded role for a strategic, hands-on leader who can turn relationships across government and industry into real opportunities for Replit. As Replit grows from a beloved developer platform into a defining company in AI and enterprise transformation, you will build the relationships and pathways that accelerate adoption across the public and private sectors.

The role sits at the intersection of corporate affairs, business development, public sector strategy, and enterprise growth. It is not a traditional government relations role focused on policy, access, or reputation. You will build a repeatable, measurable approach to turning senior-level engagement into qualified pipeline, adoption, and long-term value, working closely with the President of Public Sector and Corporate Affairs, the executive team, and sales and go-to-market leaders.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive
jobs.description:
At BioRender, we’re on a mission to accelerate the world’s ability to learn, discover, and communicate science – transforming how knowledge is shared and making science open, collaborative, and easily understandable by all.

 

We’re shaping the future of science communication and are looking for talented individuals to help bring this vision to life! 🚀

We are looking for a motivated Strategic Account Executive that has a tenacious, methodical approach to developing new business opportunities. You will work closely with members of our Leadership, Customer Success, and Business Development teams to find the right approach that ensures a great customer experience while maximizing revenue growth.

 
 

You will be successful in this role with

 - Exceptional customer curiosity: You have a genuine interest in learning about the clients we serve, their goals, and their science communication pain points. You are curious, love asking questions, and can think outside of the box.

 - Team-oriented approach: You thrive in a fast-paced environment and love working on a diverse array of collaborative projects with different internal teams.

 - Detail-oriented and data-focused approach: You are someone who is always looking for ways to improve and scale sales strategies, outreaches and playbooks.

 

What you'll be doing

 - Manage the full sales cycle, selling to academic institutions and industry companies across the globe

 - Become an expert in BioRender’s features, benefits, and use cases

 - Consistently attain and exceed all revenue and booking targets within assigned territory or category

 - Organize, categorize, and prioritize sales leads in CRM — measure lead conversion and performance against quota

 - Develop and execute on strategic account expansion plans for named enterprise accounts in assigned territory

 - Partner with Marketing, Customer Success, Product and other internal teams to continue to improve and iterate on what’s required to succeed

 

What you bring to the table

 - 7+ years of previous experience in full-cycle SaaS sales as an Account Executive

 - Proven experience closing six and seven-figure deals

 - Demonstrated success managing complex, enterprise-level sales cycles and negotiating high-value contracts

 - Experience selling highly technical products in SaaS environments

 - Bachelor’s degree in a life science discipline or prior life sciences experience (e.g. biology, biotechnology, biomedical engineering, biochemistry) a plus

 - History of consistently achieving or exceeding sales targets and have experience working on deals with multiple stakeholders

 - Strong communication skills and the ability to connect effectively with a range of stakeholders, including scientists, team project liaisons, and industry executives

 - Gritty and resourceful; you leverage tools and technology to sell strategically and efficiently

 - Strong ability to interpret feedback and apply coaching quickly

 

What you can expect from our interview process

 

 - Introductory calls: We will set up a 30-minute phone call with one of our recruiters and/or our Sales Leaders, during which you’ll have the opportunity to share more about your experience and interests. You’ll also learn more about BioRender and the team you’re interviewing with. Feel free to ask any questions throughout these calls!

Why join us?

 - BioRender is loved by millions! We have a world-class NPS and a community of loyal fans and users in 200+ countries!

 - We’re remote-first with team members across Canada and the U.S., offering you the flexibility to work from anywhere.

 

BioRender is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. By submitting this application, you consent to the processing of your personal data by BioRender in accordance with GDPR and our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Software Engineer- Maps Rendering
jobs.description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

Applied Intuition is looking for map rendering engineers with passion and expertise in owning and maintaining web rendering and editing tools geared towards HD maps for autonomous vehicles.

At Applied we treat maps not as a static dataset, but as a single integrated, self-healing data flywheel powering Physical AI. Fleets of vehicles collect ground truth from multimodal sensors which feed ingestion pipelines, dynamic change detection algorithms, machine learning models, and real-time onboard localization and map fusion —closing the loop between field data collection and instantaneous autonomy stack updates.

All of this map data needs to be visualized and edited performantly. In this full time role on the Maps team, you’ll help us build out map visualization tools that operate at every part of the process of developing an autonomy stack. You will operate across verticals - from long-haul L4 commercial trucks to L2++ personal cars, to heavy mining rigs, and tactical defense platforms - and context - real operations and simulations - to visualize standard and high definition map data, LiDAR point clouds, detailed 3D models and more.

Our map editor is used everyday by mapping specialists at Applied and across our commercial customers to triage and edit maps. We treat it as our map visualization & editing engine’s first and best customer, shipping features every single day to improve the experience. We also use our engine to power other mapping experiences across the company: you will help us build something battle-tested for a diversity of use cases. A successful candidate will be able to work across many contexts, including on-vehicle visualization, to push forward maps at Applied.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own and drive forward a 3D WebGPU map visualization and editing engine.

 - Integrate the map visualization and editing engine into experiences across the company, including our primary map editor

 - Build multiplayer web-based editing experiences

 - Hold the line and drive best practices on performance: we expect to run at 120fps on any modern machine for country-scale HD maps

 - Integrate mapping tools from across the company and industry, including map querying, map validation and programmatic map transforms

 - Help define data storage formats that support map visualization

 - Work with other engineers to develop data schemas and APIs that are visualization-friendly

 - Work across all 3D experiences at the company to ensure an integrated fit and feel

 - Advise customers on the effective use of map visualization to increase product quality and drive forward autonomy programs

REQUIREMENTS

 - BS in in Computer Science, Robotics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Graphics or related engineering field

 - 3+ years working deeply with web-based graphics: WebGL, WebGPU, three.js http://three.js or similar

 - 2+ years experience on frontend development including Typescript and one modern frontend framework (React, Svelte, Vue, SolidJS etc)

 - 3+ years of experience in mapping, preferably in HD maps used for autonomous driving

 - Engineering Practices: Scalable distributed systems, CI/CD workflows, version control, and cross-team collaboration using Jira and Git-based tooling

NICE TO HAVE

 - 2+ years working experience in backed programming & systems including: C++, Python, Go, JavaScript, SQL, Linux, and Git

 - 2+ years working on performance-critical code in systems languages including: C, C++, and Rust

 - Experience with native graphics APIs, particularly on mobile devices

 - Experience with WebAssembly

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
