Sift is the AI-powered fraud platform securing digital trust for leading global businesses. Our deep investments in machine learning and user identity, a data network scoring 1 trillion events per year, and a commitment to long-term customer success empower more than 700 customers to grow fearlessly. Global brands rely on Sift to unlock growth and deliver seamless consumer experiences. jobs.title: Founding Recruiter
jobs.description:
ABOUT PROSPER AI

Prosper is building the most advanced conversational AI agents for healthcare: human-like phone agents that handle the administrative work draining the system, including claims status checks, benefit verification, prior authorizations, patient scheduling and balance reminders. Our mission is to eliminate $200B in administrative waste so healthcare professionals can focus more on healing and less on paperwork.

 

Headquartered in New York with an office in Barcelona, we work with dozens of large and enterprise healthcare organizations, and we've raised $30M from top investors including a16z, Base10, YC and Emergence. We're a highly motivated team of 70, ex-MIT, HBS, Bain and Math/CS/Physics olympiad medalists. As we prepare for our next stage of growth, we're looking for ambitious, exceptionally talented people to help scale our team and grow with us.

 

THE ROLE

We're scaling our go-to-market team in New York, and the people we hire there decide how fast we grow. 

As our Recruiter in New York, you'll own hiring with a focus on sales, customer success and revenue operations, and support other teams as we grow, from the first conversation with the hiring manager to the signed offer. 

It's a hands-on role with real ownership. You'll build the pipelines, the interview processes and the relationships with our GTM leaders that let us hire the best people in the market, quickly. 

You'll report to our Head of People and work side by side with our founders, our GTM leaders and our Recruiter in Barcelona. This role is in person in our New York City office.

 
 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Run GTM searches end to end: kick-off with the hiring manager, sourcing, screening, interviews, offers and closing

 - Hire across sales, customer success and revenue operations, from SDRs and BDRs to senior account executives

 - Source directly and build pipelines of top performers who aren't looking yet, so most of your hires come from your own outreach

 - Work with GTM leaders to define what each role needs, how we assess it, including role plays and track record, and what a great candidate looks like

 - Close candidates with a clear and honest pitch, including how base, variable and equity work at Prosper

 - Give every candidate a fast and respectful process, working with our Workplace & Culture Manager in New York on scheduling and office visits

 - Keep Ashby up to date and report on pipeline, time to hire and conversion for each search

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting, mostly for sales and go-to-market roles at a fast-growing tech startup

 - You've hired account executives and SDRs and can walk us through searches you ran from kick-off to signed offer

 - You know how to assess sales talent: quota attainment, deal sizes, sales cycles and how to check them

 - Strong sourcing: you find top performers who aren't looking and get them interested in talking to us

 - You run several searches at once without dropping anything, and hiring managers and candidates never have to chase you for an update

 - You give hiring managers a clear point of view, backed by data, and push back when a process or a profile isn't working

 

Nice to Have:

 

 - Experience hiring for healthcare, health tech or enterprise SaaS sales teams

 - A network in the New York sales and startup community

 - Experience with Ashby or another modern applicant tracking system

 - Spanish

 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - GTM leaders see you as a partner in their searches and trust your read on candidates

 - Most of the people you hire came through your own sourcing

 - The people you hire ramp well and hit their targets

 - Candidates rate our process highly, including the ones we didn't hire

 - Time from kick-off to signed offer goes down, and you can show us the data

 

WHY PROSPER

 - Work on products that are transforming US healthcare operations, at the core of conversational AI

 - Real ownership and impact from day one, alongside a team that has built and scaled a fast-growing Series A company backed by top Silicon Valley investors

 - Significant growth opportunities as the company scales

 - An international team across New York and Barcelona

 - A culture that rewards bold thinking, analytical rigor and tangible results

 - Build the team that takes Prosper to market as we scale in the US

 

INTERVIEWING PROCESS

 1. Initial conversation to understand who you are, what you want to do and where you want to go (30 minutes)

 2. A written exercise at home: how you would run one of our real GTM searches (around 1 hours)

 3. A live session with our Head of People where we go through your exercise and talk about how you work (60 minutes)

 4. Conversation with a co-founder (30 minutes)

 5. Offer stage

jobs.title: Forward Deployment Engineer
jobs.description:
SingleStore is seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to operate at the intersection of solution architecture, technical delivery, and customer partnership. This role combines elements of a solutions architect, technical account manager, and solution engineer, with a strong emphasis on execution. 
 As an FDE, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor and sounding board for customers, helping them design, implement, and scale real-time data solutions using SingleStore. You will work closely with customers to understand their business objectives, translate them into technical strategies, and drive those solutions into production. This role requires a delivery mindset, strong technical depth, and the ability to lead both strategic conversations and hands-on execution. 
 Role and Responsibilities 
 
 Partner directly with customers to understand their architecture, use cases, and business goals, and translate them into scalable technical solutions. 
 Design and implement end-to-end solutions integrating SingleStore into existing application and data ecosystems. 
 Lead whiteboard sessions to shape ideas, define architecture, and convert concepts into technical specifications and execution plans. 
 Act as a proactive thought partner, bringing ideas and guiding conversations rather than reacting to requirements. 
 Own delivery of high-impact initiatives from concept through production, ensuring successful outcomes. 
 Provide hands-on support, including troubleshooting, optimization, and applying pragmatic solutions or fixes when needed. 
 Collaborate closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Engineering teams to align customer needs with product capabilities and roadmap. 
 Help customers prioritize and operationalize their data initiatives, balancing ambition with practical delivery. 
 Feed insights from customer engagements back into Product and Engineering to influence roadmap and improvements. 
 
 Your Experience 
 
 10+ years of experience in solution architecture, solution engineering, or technical consulting (pre-sales and/or post-sales). 
 Strong foundation in databases, distributed systems, or software engineering. 
 Proven experience delivering production-grade solutions in customer-facing environments. 
 Experience integrating complex systems across data pipelines, applications, and infrastructure. 
 Ability to translate ambiguous requirements into clear technical plans and drive execution. 
 Experience working with enterprise customers, particularly in financial services or high-tech environments, is highly preferred. 
 Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to guide both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 Demonstrated ability to balance technical innovation with pragmatic delivery and realistic scoping. 
 Alignment with product capabilities and roadmap, ensuring solutions are both impactful and feasible. 
 
 SingleStore delivers the cloud-native database with the speed and scale to power the world’s data-intensive applications. With a distributed SQL database that introduces simplicity to your data architecture by unifying transactions and analytics, SingleStore empowers digital leaders to deliver exceptional, real-time data experiences to their customers. SingleStore is venture-backed and headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Sunnyvale, Raleigh, Seattle, Boston, London, Lisbon, Bangalore, Dublin and Kyiv. 
 Consistent with our commitment to diversity & inclusion, we value individuals with the ability to work on diverse teams and with a diverse range of people. 
 To all recruitment agencies: SingleStore does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to SingleStore employees. SingleStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company. 
 SingleStore values individuals for their unique skills and experiences, and we’re proud to offer roles in a variety of locations across the United States. Salary is based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location, and is just one part of our total compensation and benefits package. Certain roles are also eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases and annual bonuses. 
 SingleStore’s base salary range for this role, if based in States: $120,000- $200,000 USD per year 
 For candidates residing in California, please see our California Recruitment Privacy Notice . For candidates residing in the EEA, UK, and Switzerland, please see our EEA, UK, and Swiss Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.description:

 Solution Engineers (SEs) at SingleStore are solving some of the most cutting-edge technical challenges in today’s data-driven world. When customers evaluate SingleStore, SEs are their trusted technical experts who evaluate, identify, and demonstrate how SingleStore can solve their mission-critical business needs. As key contributors to our sales organization, Solution Engineers add tremendous value to the customer journey and directly impact company growth and revenue. 
 In this role, you will be responsible for identifying the technical requirements necessary to deliver business value for our Fortune 1,000 customers. Working in partnership with Enterprise Account Executives, you will help to acquire new customers and expand existing accounts. You will do this by leveraging your technical skill set and business acumen to understand complex solutions and create high-quality demos that resonate with our customers. 
 Role and Responsibilities 
 
 Partner with Prospects and Customers to understand their industries and strategies, and educate them on SingleStores strategy, technologies and vision. 
 Partner with Account Executives to close new business (logos) and expand existing accounts

 Required Skills and Experience 
 
 Fluency in English and regional languages 
 Experience with Gen AI, ML and Advanced Analytics 
 Experience successfully selling enterprise database technologies, distributed systems, and similar products 
 Deep understanding of distributed database technologies, including both analytic and transactional processing 
 Expertise executing POCs, with experience designing and deploying complex technologies into existing customer environments 
 In-Depth understanding of data platforms, including various competitive products (Oracle, SQL Server, Postgres, MongoDB, Snowflake, Databricks, etc.)

 SingleStore is a global database company that empowers the world’s leading organizations to build and scale cutting-edge AI applications on a unified data platform that supports real-time transactions, analytics, and search. jobs.title: Regional Vice President
jobs.description:
SingleStore is seeking a regional sales leader to lead the east regional new-logo seller team focused on customer acquisition. Reporting to the CRO, this leader will lead the Americas sales organization across Enterprise, Commercial, and Strategic segments, with a primary mandate to accelerate net-new logo acquisition. 
 This role is accountable for building a repeatable, measurable new-logo engine through fearless prospecting, excellent discovery, champion creation, disciplined deal execution, and strong activity inspection. 
 SingleStore is at an important growth point, expanding both revenue and employee count as it helps customers modernize data environments and build AI-powered applications. This is an opportunity to build and lead a strong new-logo team across the Americas and join the momentum of the company’s next phase. You’ll have real ownership of the strategy, the team, and how we go after the market, while staying close to the customers and deals that matter most. The goal is to build a team and sales motion that can win consistently and scale. 
 What You’ll Do 
 
 Own the regional new-logo plan, territory coverage, pipeline target, and execution rhythm for the AE Hunter team. 
 Recruit, coach, and develop regional sellers through clear goals, regular 1:1s, call and discovery reviews, deal coaching, and actionable feedback. 
 Set a high-urgency operating cadence for outbound activity, outreach quality, first meetings, discovery progression, pipeline creation, and new-logo attainment. 
 Inspect activity and outcomes—not just forecasts—including outreach volume and quality, meetings, discovery conversion, pipeline created, stage progression, win rate, sales-cycle velocity, quota attainment, and new-logo performance. 
 Use transparent reporting and metrics to identify gaps early, improve conversion, and hold the team accountable to agreed actions. 
 Coach AEs to prospect fearlessly, lead great business-first discovery, build champions, multi-thread buying groups, and create quantified customer value. 
 Lead weekly pipeline, opportunity, forecast, and activity reviews; improve qualification, deal strategy, forecast accuracy, and close execution. 
 Partner with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Sales Development, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success to improve pipeline quality and first production outcomes. 
 Personally engage in priority new-logo pursuits through executive alignment, inspection, coaching, and close strategy. 
 
 What You Bring 
 
 10+ years of enterprise software, SaaS, cloud, data, analytics, AI, or related technology sales experience, including 5+ years leading quota-carrying teams. 
 A proven record of building high-performing new-logo teams and generating outbound pipeline in complex enterprise markets. 
 Strong operating discipline and fluency with activity metrics, pipeline coverage, conversion analysis, forecast inspection, CRM, and reporting. 
 A hands-on coaching approach grounded in call review, discovery inspection, deal inspection, and measurable behavior change. 
 Experience coaching sellers on prospecting, discovery, champion building, executive engagement, business value, and competitive selling. 
 Strong understanding of enterprise technology buyers and modern data, AI, and cloud priorities. 
 Executive presence, sound judgment, high standards, and the ability to balance urgency with trust. 
 Willingness to travel regularly across the Americas for customers, partners, team engagement, and company events. 
 
 How Success Will Be Measured 
 
 Consistent, qualified regional pipeline creation and coverage 
 Improved outreach-to-meeting and meeting-to-opportunity conversion 
 Strong discovery quality, champion development, and multi-threaded opportunities 
 New-logo attainment, win rate, sales-cycle velocity, and first production workloads 
 Accurate forecasts, clean CRM, timely reporting, and visible activity inspection 
 Seller productivity, coaching impact, retention, and talent development

jobs.title: Perception Engineer, Autonomy (Air Domain)
jobs.description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Perception Engineer, you will help build the perception layer of an autonomy stack for uncrewed air vehicles. The team turns noisy, intermittent data from many sensors and teammates into a reliable picture of the airspace. 

This role spans classical state estimation and tracking, sensor fusion, and learning-based prediction. Increasingly, those models adapt online during an engagement from limited and delayed feedback. The engineer will design and implement real-time C++ algorithms, build the tooling and simulation studies that show whether they work, and carry ideas from research prototypes into deployable software. We need someone fluent in both estimation theory and machine learning, rigorous about measuring results, and comfortable working at the line between research and production.

 

AT APPLIED INTUITION, YOU WILL:

 - Develop, integrate, and adapt cutting-edge AI/ML algorithms running on the perception autonomy stack to collect relevant information across a suite of platform sensors

 - Create interfacing software to autonomously control sensors (e.g., EO, IR, acoustics, radar, and RF)

 - Collaborate across the sensor, tracking, and autonomy teams to ensure seamless deployment of heterogeneous platform swarms in on-site DoD testing and demonstration events

 - Deploy containerized solutions to embedded Linux devices, leveraging computer-in-the-loop testing and profiling, and efficiently collecting performance data

 - Interact with the DoD customer to understand their use cases, requirements, and triage needs during field events to deliver a superior customer experience
 

WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS:

 - BS/MS in Electrical, Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field, plus 3+ years building perception or estimation software for autonomous systems.

 - Strong modern C++ (17/20) for real-time, performance-critical code on Linux. Comfortable with linear algebra libraries (e.g. Eigen) and profiling.

 - Solid grounding in state estimation: Kalman filter variants (EKF/UKF), multiple-model filters (IMM), and covariance and uncertainty handling.

 - Experience with multi-target tracking and sensor fusion: data association, track management, and fusing heterogeneous sensors that report intermittently and with noise.

 - Working knowledge of machine learning for prediction, including sequence models (RNN/LSTM, transformers), training pipelines, and evaluating models on held-out data.

 - Python for data pipelines, analysis and visualization of logged and simulated runs.

 - Experience validating algorithms in simulation and with recorded data: designing experiments, defining metrics, and reading results honestly.

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Vision, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical field2+ years of experience in industry.

Security Requirements:

 - Must be a U.S. Citizen

 - Must hold or be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance

For more information about U.S. security clearances: click here https://www.state.gov/securityclearances.

NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience with online, real-time learning: models that adapt during operation, not just offline training.

 - Background in adaptive control or learning-based estimation (e.g. concurrent learning, Lyapunov-based learning, Bayesian or recursive least-squares parameter estimation).

 - Experience learning from intermittent, delayed or sparse feedback, where ground truth arrives late or only sometimes.

 - Behavior and intent prediction for other agents, including models of non-cooperative or adversarial actors.

 - Deploying small neural networks in C++ without heavy ML frameworks, under tight latency and compute budgets.

Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Development Representative - London
jobs.description:
BUILDING A MORE RESILIENT WORLD

When things go wrong, insurance has one job: get people and businesses back on their feet. Too often, it doesn't. At ClaimSorted, we're changing that, and building a more resilient world where people and businesses have the confidence to go after bigger opportunities.

We're creating the company that will define how claims are handled for the next generation. The world's largest insurers and Fortune 500 companies already trust us to handle their claims and manage their risk.

And we're moving fast. We grew 10x in the past year, raised one of the largest InsurTech rounds of its kind, and are backed by Y Combinator, Atomico and Eurazeo. We ship, learn and improve every week, never settling for "how it's always been done."

We're just getting started. There's never been a better time to join.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Sales Development Representative to join our founding GTM team and create a steady pipeline of qualified leads for our Strategic Account Executives (SAEs). You’ll be the first conversation most of our future customers have with ClaimSorted, finding the right people at the largest insurance and Fortune 500 companies in the world and giving them a reason to listen.

You’ll be measured on two things:

 - Volume: a high level of prospecting across email, LinkedIn, phone and other channels

 - Conversion: a high prospect-to-qualified-meeting rate, so every meeting you hand to an SAE is worth their time
 
 

What you’ll do:

 - Research accounts, identify the right stakeholders, and build targeted lead lists at the largest insurance and Fortune 500 companies

 - Run high-volume outbound across email, LinkedIn, phone and whatever else cuts through with people who get pitched constantly

 - Treat outreach as a structured process, using AI tools to research, personalize and scale your prospecting without losing quality

 - Qualify relentlessly, so every meeting you book is a real opportunity and not noise

 - Own top-of-funnel end to end, from first touch to a booked, qualified meeting handed to an SAE

 - Refine our outbound messaging as you go, feeding what you learn from hundreds of conversations back into how we message and target

 - Work directly with Claims and Product, so what you hear from prospects shapes how we position what we build next

We love working together in the office, so this is a full-time, in-office role in our London office. We’re a high-intensity team and often put in significant time and effort, because we believe great outcomes come from doing the work well.

WHO YOU ARE

You have at least a year in a communications-heavy role, ideally in sales or something adjacent (SDR/BDR, recruiting, customer success, account management or similar), and you’re ready to step up into a high-growth enterprise sales environment.

 - Great written and spoken communicator: you can get a stranger to reply to a cold email or pick up the phone, and you keep sharpening your messaging when the data says it isn’t landing

 - A sharp researcher: you can quickly work out who the relevant people are at a large organization and what would make them care

 - AI-fluent: you use AI tools to do better prospecting, and you treat outreach as a structured, repeatable process rather than ad hoc effort

 - Built for volume: you stay sharp and motivated through a lot of “no” on the way to “yes”

 - Coachable and fast-learning: you take feedback on your outreach and improve week over week, not quarter over quarter

 - Organized and process-driven: you keep a high-volume pipeline clean so nothing falls through the cracks

 - Ambitious: you want this to be the start of a sales career, not a one-year stop
 
 

OUR VALUES

 - Move Fast – Act decisively, iterate quickly, optimize for momentum.

 - Always Overdeliver – We exceed expectations in everything we do.

 - Think Customer-First, Always – The customer experience drives every decision.

 - Challenge the Status Quo – We innovate relentlessly and never settle for ‘good enough.’

 - Say It How It Is – Transparency and direct communication build trust.
 
 

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Generous, transparent equity participation

 - 28 days annual leave plus bank holidays

 - 30 days of remote work annually

 - Private medical insurance

 - Pension contributions

 - Company offsites

 - Accelerated promotion track in a high-growth environment

jobs.title: Founding BDR
jobs.description:
Interfere is building the self-healing layer of the internet: software that detects broken product experiences, understands what caused them, and helps teams fix them before users notice.

Modern teams have logs, dashboards, traces, and session replay. They still find out about too many problems from their users. We exist to close that gap for engineers, PMs, designers, and founders who care how their product actually works in the real world.

The product surface is large. The category is still being defined. The people who join now will help shape how the company grows.

We've raised $5.1M from Y Combinator, Vercel Ventures, Hummingbird, Designer Fund, and others. We're in person in New York City.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're hiring our founding BDR to build outbound at Interfere from the ground up. You'll be our first dedicated outbound hire, with real ownership over how we generate pipeline, what we test, and how we build a function that can scale well beyond one person.

This is a hands-on role. You'll spend your days researching accounts, prospecting, writing outreach, following up, and booking meetings. You'll work directly with our Head of Strategy and Growth, with significant autonomy over how you operate. We want someone who brings ideas, moves quickly, and takes responsibility for making outbound better every week.

The systems you build and the lessons you learn will shape how we hire and scale the team from here. You'll get exposure to the full sales process, see how deals get done, and have the opportunity to take on significantly more responsibility as Interfere grows. For someone genuinely ambitious and early in their career, there's a lot of room to run.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Generate pipeline. Research target companies, identify decision-makers, build prospect lists, write outreach, run campaigns across email, LinkedIn, phone, socials, and other channels, and consistently generate qualified meetings.

 - Figure out what works. Test targeting, messaging and channels, track what's converting, and iterate quickly. Double down on what works and change what doesn't.

 - Build the outbound function. Develop the sequences, workflows, prospecting processes, reporting and systems needed to make outbound repeatable. Use AI and automation wherever they can meaningfully improve our output.

 - Understand our customers. Learn Interfere's product and the problems we're solving. Understand what matters to CTOs and engineering leaders, and use that understanding to make outreach more relevant and effective.

We expect you to bring proven experience, learn fast, take ownership, and continuously improve how we operate. We're not looking for someone who needs a playbook - we're looking for someone who can help build one.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for someone who's already proven they can succeed as a BDR and is ready for significantly more ownership.

 - You know how to generate pipeline. Ideally 1–3 years in an outbound-focused BDR/SDR role at a B2B SaaS company, preferably selling developer tools or into engineering teams. You have a proven track record of generating qualified pipeline, know what good looks like, and can hit the ground running.

 - Sharp, personable, and commercially aware. You can get your head around a technical product quickly, communicate clearly, and hold credible conversations with senior engineering leaders. Strong judgment matters as much as raw intelligence.

 - You want more than another BDR job. You're willing to put in the repetitive work, handle rejection, and keep pushing when things aren't working. You're competitive, genuinely ambitious, driven to deliver results, and motivated to progress quickly in your career.

 - You figure things out. You don't wait to be told what to do every day. When something isn't working, you identify the problem, try alternatives and learn from the results. You're comfortable operating without a fully established playbook.

 - You want to build something that lasts. You care about building better processes, improving conversion, and finding ways to make the operation more effective. If something works, you want to understand why and figure out how to repeat it.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - $80,000–$90,000 base salary + $30,000 target commission ($110,000–$120,000 OTE)

 - Equity compensation

 - Direct exposure to leadership and the full sales process

 - Significant ownership over how our outbound function is built and operated

 - Opportunity for accelerated career progression and increasing responsibility as Interfere grows

You'll be joining early, doing real work from day one, and helping build a function that could become a major part of how Interfere grows.

If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Founding Research Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAINDROP

Raindrop http://raindrop.ai/ is the monitoring platform for AI agents. Engineering teams at Fortune 100s and the fastest-growing AI companies (Vercel, Speak, Clay) use it to catch silent failures in production. When an agent misbehaves, Raindrop alerts the team, links to the trace, and surfaces the root cause so they can fix it fast. With Raindrop 2.0 (Self-Healing Agents) https://www.raindrop.ai/blog/introducing-raindrop-2/, the loop closes itself: your coding agent fixes it, and the fix becomes an eval to prevent regressions.

WHY IT MATTERS

AI agents fail constantly in ways both hilarious and terrifying. Regular software throws exceptions. But AI agents fail silently, leaving engineers with almost no visibility into how their agents are actually performing.

The current status quo is sifting through millions of logs and trying to debug flaky evals that just aren't matching real world results. Evals are like unit tests, they confirm your model got specific test cases right. But in the real world agents call thousands of tools, run for hours, and encounter millions of unpredictable actions.

That’s where Raindrop comes in. It learns the unique shape of each AI agent’s issues. Starting from presets like Laziness, Forgetting, or Task Failure, to automatically tuning itself to each agent and discovering unknown unknowns.

With one click of a button, AI engineers start tracking issues or topics across 100% of their production data. They can see frequency over time, how many users are affected, relevant properties and more.

In order to process hundreds of millions of events, we gradually train small, custom models, private to each company, that learn to uniquely understand how their product is used.

As part of the early team, you’ll play a fundamental role in shaping the company - from making strategy and product decisions, to helping scale the team, to shaping the future of AI agents.

OUR INVESTORS

We've raised $50M total https://www.raindrop.ai/blog/series-a/, led by CRV, with backing from Lightspeed, Figma Ventures, Vercel Ventures, and the founders of Replit (Amjad Masad, Michele Catasta), Cognition (Walden Yan), Framer (Koen Bok, Jorn van Dijk), Speak (Andrew Hsu), and Notion (Akshay Kothari).

About the role:

We’re looking for a founding Research Engineer to study how AI agents behave in production. You’ll join an early team, set the research agenda, and publish what we learn.

Your Focus:

 - Agent behavior: Discover how agents fail and respond to different conditions in the real world, and what that means for monitoring and safety.

 - Simulations: Advance how we simulate agents and the situations they face before they reach users.

 - Detection: Develop new methods for finding issues no one has defined yet.

 - Open questions: High-upside bets on questions about agents we haven’t thought to ask yet.

Your responsibilities:

 - Set Raindrop’s research agenda and run the experiments behind it.

 - Design evaluations and metrics for problems where the ground truth is unclear.

 - Publish findings as papers, blog posts, and talks.

 - Prototype new methods, and bring the ones that work into the product when it makes sense.

 - Help define what research looks like at Raindrop as the team and product grows.

Ideal Candidate:

 - You make complex ideas clear through strong written and communication skills.

 - Care about sharing your research through publications, open-source work, or public write-ups.

 - Deep expertise in an area such as interpretability, evals, AI safety, anomaly detection, or representation learning.

 - Good judgment about which experiments are worth running and when a result is real.

 - You ship experiments and build prototypes 

 - Use and build AI agents and tools

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Intern – Benchmarking
jobs.description:
ABOUT MERCOR

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Research Engineer at Mercor, you’ll work at the intersection of engineering and applied AI research. You’ll own benchmarking pipelines, evaluation systems, and failure analysis workflows that directly inform how we train and improve frontier language models.
Your work will define how we measure tool use, agentic behavior, and real-world reasoning. You’ll design and run evals, build rubrics and scorers, and turn failure analysis into actionable improvements for post-training, RLVR, and data pipelines.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Benchmarking: Design, implement, and maintain benchmarks and metrics for tool use, agentic behavior, and real-world reasoning; ensure benchmarks scale with training and stay aligned with product and research goals.

 - Evaluation systems: Build and operate LLM evaluation systems end-to-end runs, scoring, dashboards, and reporting, so researchers and applied AI teams can track model performance and compare runs at scale.

 - Failure analysis: Run systematic failure analysis on model outputs (e.g., wrong tool use, reasoning errors, safety/alignment issues); categorize failure modes, quantify prevalence, and feed findings into reward design, data curation, and benchmark design.

 - Rubrics and evaluators: Create and refine rubrics, automated evaluators, and scoring frameworks that drive training and evaluation decisions; balance rigor with scalability (human vs. model-as-judge, calibration, agreement).

 - Data quality and usability: Quantify data usability, quality, and impact on key benchmarks; use evals and failure analysis to guide data generation, augmentation, and curation.

 - Cross-team collaboration: Work with AI researchers, applied AI teams, and data producers to align evals with training objectives and to prioritize benchmarks and failure analyses that matter most.

 - Ownership in a fast-paced environment: Operate in a high-iteration research setting with strong ownership of benchmarks, evals, and failure-analysis workflows.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong applied research background, with focus on model evaluation, benchmarking, and/or failure analysis.

 - Strong coding skills and hands-on experience with ML models and evaluation code.

 - Solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and backend systems.

 - Comfort with APIs, SQL/NoSQL, and cloud platforms for running and storing eval results.

 - Ability to reason about model behavior, experimental results, and data quality from evals and failure analyses.

 - Excitement to work in person in San Francisco five days a week in a high-intensity, high-ownership environment.

NICE TO HAVE

 - Industry experience on a post-training or evaluation/benchmarking team (highest priority).

 - Publications at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ACL), especially in evaluation or benchmarking.

 - Experience building or running LLM evaluations, benchmarks, or failure-analysis pipelines.

 - Experience with synthetic data generation, rubric design, or RL-style workflows that use evals for reward shaping.

 - Work samples or code (e.g., eval frameworks, benchmark suites, failure-analysis reports or tooling) that demonstrate relevant skills.

BENEFITS

About us

We’re a fast-growing fintech on a mission to redefine how Latin America manages its finances and this is your opportunity to be a crucial part of that transformation. Join a team of top talent from the world’s leading fintech and tech companies, and help build a cross-border financial system that’s modern, accessible, and built to scale.

Who we’re looking for

We are looking for a Chief Compliance Officer to lead ARQ’s US investment compliance functions, serve as CCO for our SEC-registered investment adviser, and act as the proposed CCO for our introducing broker-dealer through its FINRA New Member Application (NMA) and launch. You will bring prior CCO experience across both SEC-registered RIAs and FINRA broker-dealers, with a strong understanding of digital investment platforms and clearing broker relationships.

This is a hands-on role. You will oversee the RIA’s compliance program, help lead the broker-dealer application, and build the supervisory framework for launch. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Legal, the BSA/AML Officer, and the outsourced FINOP to embed effective controls in ARQ’s investment offering.

What you’ll do:

 1. RIA program ownership: Administer the RIA’s compliance policies, risk assessment, monitoring, testing, and documented annual review. Maintain the compliance calendar and report material risks and remediation progress to leadership.

 2. FINRA application and launch: Help lead the NMA with FINRA, counsel, and internal teams. Develop written supervisory procedures, prepare supporting materials, respond to information requests, participate in the membership interview, and verify compliance readiness before launch.

 3. Broker dealer supervision: Build and lead the compliance and supervisory framework for a fully disclosed introducing broker offering self-directed trading. Establish assigned supervisory responsibilities, account and transaction reviews, supervisory testing, escalation processes, and required annual reporting.

 4. Digital investment advice: Oversee compliance controls for automated, non-discretionary recommendations, including client questionnaires, risk profiles, portfolio methodology, algorithm testing, change management, and ongoing monitoring. Maintain clear disclosures and separation between advisory recommendations and independent customer trading.

 5. Marketing and communications: Review investment marketing, performance presentations, promotions, app content, and customer communications against applicable SEC and FINRA standards. Maintain approval records and electronic communications supervision.

 6. Disclosures and registrations: Manage Form ADV, Form CRS, Form BD, relevant amendments, and client delivery obligations. Coordinate individual registrations, continuing education, advisory agreements, and customer disclosures.

 7. Conflicts and conduct: Maintain the code of ethics and controls for personal trading, outside business activities, gifts and entertainment, and affiliate conflicts. Oversee fiduciary-duty controls and assess custody implications, fees, and collateral arrangements.

 8. Clearing and brokerage operations: Oversee compliance with introducing and clearing responsibilities, including account opening, order handling, applicable best execution obligations, transfers, and customer complaints. Coordinate with the clearing broker and outsourced FINOP on operational controls and regulatory obligations.

 9. Records and customer protection: Maintain compliant books and records, communications retention, privacy and safeguarding controls, and complaint handling. Work with Security and Engineering on incident response and customer notification processes.

 10. Examinations and coordination: Lead SEC and FINRA examinations and inquiries, coordinate audits and remediation, and train employees. Partner with the BSA/AML Officer on investment-related financial crime risks and clearly document responsibilities across teams.

What you’ll need to succeed

 - 10+ years of progressive securities compliance experience, with prior service as CCO for an SEC-registered investment adviser or FINRA broker-dealer.

 - FINRA Series 24 qualification required.

 - Direct experience supporting or leading a FINRA NMA, including supervisory procedures, regulatory responses, membership interviews, and preparation for launch.

 - Strong knowledge of the Investment Advisers Act, Securities Exchange Act, SEC adviser requirements, and FINRA rules covering supervision, communications, records, registrations, and customer protection.

 - Experience with fully disclosed introducing broker-dealers and clearing firms, including the division of compliance and operational responsibilities.

 - Hands-on experience administering RIA annual reviews, marketing reviews, conflicts controls, codes of ethics, regulatory filings, and examinations.

Argon builds the AI workforce to support all the tasks that happen downstream of discovery. Our work has touched 100s of drugs across oncology, immunology, cardio, infectious diseases, and more with purpose-built AI for biopharma's commercial and clinical teams, specialized from the data model up.

jobs.description:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile. 

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. 

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Product Data Scientist who is deeply product-minded and highly proactive.

This is not a role for someone who waits for perfectly defined questions or works in isolation. We are looking for someone who actively looks at our data, understands our customers’ pain points, identifies opportunities, and pushes ideas forward.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Analytics to shape what we build, why we build it, and how we measure success. Your work will directly power customer-facing features such as LTV prediction, experimentation and statistical significance, benchmarking, and entirely new data-driven products we have not built yet.

You will be expected to bring ideas to the table, backed by analysis and clear hypotheses, and to influence product direction through data.

Our data stack includes a Python backend, PostgreSQL production databases, Snowflake, dbt, and AWS.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Proactively explore RevenueCat’s data to identify customer problems, opportunities, and product bets.

 - Translate ambiguous product and business problems and questions into clear analyses, models, and recommendations.

 - Partner with Product Managers to shape roadmaps, not just execute on them.

 - Design, build, and ship production-grade predictive and descriptive models that power customer-facing features.

 - Define and evaluate statistical approaches for experimentation, benchmarking, and forecasting.

 - Communicate insights clearly and persuasively to technical and non-technical audiences, with a focus on customer impact.

 - Continuously iterate on shipped models and features based on real-world usage and feedback.

This role has real ownership. You will not just support decisions, you will help drive them.

ABOUT YOU

You are a Senior Data Scientist who cares deeply about impact and product outcomes.

From a skills perspective, you bring:

 - 5+ years of experience working as a Data Scientist.

 - Strong SQL skills and comfort with data modeling.

 - Experience building and deploying predictive and descriptive models in production.

 - Experience writing or collaborating on production-ready Python code.

 - A solid understanding of statistics and experimentation, ideally including Bayesian approaches.

 - The ability to clearly explain complex ideas and results to broad audiences.

 - You are highly proactive and opinionated, and you are comfortable pushing ideas forward.

 - You enjoy working with messy, real-world data and imperfect information.

 - You care more about creating customer value than academic elegance.

 - You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and building structure where none exists.

 - You enjoy working closely with Product teams and influencing decisions.

 - You are excited by the consumer subscription ecosystem and curious about how developers make money.

 As an early mover in the in-space transportation and infrastructure services, Momentus is at the forefront of the commercialization of space. With an experienced team of aerospace, propulsion, and robotics engineers, Momentus has developed a cost-effective and energy-efficient in-space transport system. 
 OUR PEOPLE 
 Daring problems require daring solutions. We boldly charge into uncharted territory knowing that no matter the outcome we will benefit from the journey and move closer to our goals no matter what. Our teams know that working at Momentus means more than building innovative technology, it means creating entirely new markets in the space economy. We are level-headed, business-minded strategic thinkers intent on providing immediate value to our customers today while simultaneously preparing for the vast possibilities of the future. If this sounds like you, we should talk. 
 JOB SUMMARY 
 We are seeking an Electrical Avionics Engineer to design, build, test, and fly a variety of avionics units to support Momentus vehicles. This includes high-performance, low cost, and low-mass flight computers, cameras, and power systems. The ideal candidate should be accustomed to working in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working on challenging problems. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 
 Develop avionics units in one or more of the following areas: 
 
 Flight computer, data handling, and payload interface systems 
 Power converters and power distribution systems 
 Attitude determination sensors and cameras 
 Radio communication systems 
 High power microwave amplifiers 
 
 
 Perform PCB schematic capture and layout 
 Perform detailed technical review of electronics design and PCB layouts 
 Assist in developing test plans for flight qualification of avionics (TVAC, vibe, thermal, radiation, EMC/EMI, etc.) 
 
 Preferred Skills and Experience: 
 
 Experience with schematic capture and PCB layout in Altium Designer 
 Experience designing electronics for the space environment (LEO, GEO and deep space) including radiation, thermal, and vibe 
 Experience defining spacecraft avionics architectures and developing associated budgets 
 Experience performing radiation test campaigns 
 Familiarity with embedded software development 
 Deep technical expertise in at least one of the following areas: 
 
 High-speed digital design: FPGAs, microprocessors, high speed memory, high speed communication buses 
 Power electronics: power converters, load switches, etc. 
 RF electronics: mixers, local oscillators, power amplifiers 
 Mixed-signal electronics: ADCs and DACs, image sensors, analog front-ends 
 
 
 Experience with circuit simulation software such as LTSpice 
 Experience designing fault-tolerant systems 
 Previous experience working on DoD and other USG development and deployment programs 
 Ability to hold and maintain a USG Security Clearance 
 
 Education & Work Experience: 
 
 BS degree in Electrical Engineering, or a closely related discipline 
 5-8 years relevant experience. 
 
 Compensation: 
 Annual Base Salary Range: $140,000 - $175,000/per year Base pay is one part of our total compensation package (base+bonus+equity) and is determined within a range. Your actual base salary will be determined on job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Our benefit plans include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k retirement plan, short and long term disability and life insurance. We also offer flexible PTO, along with 11 paid holidays, sick time and paid parental leave. 
 This is a full-time position in San Jose, California. This position requires access to export-controlled commodities, technical data, technology, software, and services. U.S. citizenship, U.S. legal permanent resident status, or protected person status under 8 U.S.C. Â§ 1324b(a)(3) is required. 
 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. 
 To all recruitment agencies: Momentus does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our employees or any company email. Momentus will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

SYSTEM MAINTENANCE & SUPPORT

 - Proficiency with industrial communication protocols (Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus, OPC UA)

 - Capability to modify circuits (e.g., resistors, capacitors) to resolve signal problems

LANGUAGE & COMMUNICATION

🌟 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

💼 BENEFITS

jobs.title: Head of Brand
jobs.description:
👋 HEY! WE'RE CONVEO.AI http://Conveo.ai

Conveo helps the world's biggest brands understand the people who buy from them. Our AI interviewer holds real video conversations with consumers, hundreds at a time, in any language, and turns what people say, show, and feel into insight that teams act on. Research that used to be possible only in small, occasional doses is now something brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange run continuously, at a depth and scale that was out of reach before. We are YC-backed, closed a $50M Series A, and growing fast.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/49c7399e-a401-4987-ab34-2ca5e18d2f29/3519e886-495e-4d41-8a3b-439b2a607aea/pictures.jpg]

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Before anyone reads a word we write, they have already formed an opinion of us from how we look.

Every month, Conveo ships hundreds of pieces of visual work: the website, landing pages, sales decks, films, social posts, event booths, reports that land on the desks of executives at Unilever, Google, and Orange. That work is made by many hands, internal people, external partners, freelancers, and increasingly AI agents. What is missing is the one person who owns what it all adds up to.

That is this role. You hold the visual language of the entire company: what Conveo looks like, why it looks that way, and how every team, from marketing to sales to events to the founders themselves, produces work that looks like it came from the same brain. When a buyer decides in three seconds whether we look like a company they can trust with their biggest questions, they are judging your work.

The timing is the once-in-a-career part. We are rebuilding the entire brand this year, with a funded rebrand agency, a funded freelance bench, and a green field behind them. Most Head of Brand inherit an identity and spend years defending it. You arrive at the moment ours gets created, and you decide what it becomes.

There is one more thing that makes this seat unusual. Conveo runs on AI agents: they draft, produce, and publish across marketing and sales every day. Your design system will be executed by people and by machines. When you encode a rule well, our agents apply it on every asset, at any hour, at a volume no design team could match. You may be the first Head of Brand anywhere whose taste ships through an agent workforce. If teaching machines your eye excites you rather than threatens you, keep reading.

THE CONTEXT

Marketing here runs as a film-studio. A small senior core holds taste, project teams are cast from a funded freelance network, and AI agents carry production volume. Design work also flows through external partners: one for content visuals, one for the product design system, and the incoming rebrand agency. The seam between all of them needs a single owner. You are that owner, and you own it the way the best do: from the work.

You report to the CMO, who is the single approver for marketing, so decisions happen in one conversation. You partner daily with the Head of Video Content, the Product Marketing Manager, our events lead, sales, and the external design partners.

YOUR MISSION

1. BE THE VISUAL BRAIN OF THE COMPANY

One cohesive, distinctive vision, originating from the brand system, applied everywhere by everyone.

 - Shape the visual vision for Conveo and hold it across web, landing pages, decks, social, events, video, sales collateral, and product marketing

 - Make the vision legible: anyone in the company should be able to say what Conveo looks like and why

 - Govern the seam between our content partner, the product design system partner, and the rebrand agency so one language survives across product and brand

 - Review inbound work against the system and send back what misses, with reasons

 - Keep the character intact as volume grows: warm stone ground, single accent, serif headlines, real photography, generous whitespace

2. STEWARD THE VISUAL IDENTITY, HANDS ON

An identity is only as strong as the weakest asset that ships under it, so the steward works from inside the work: tightening the hierarchy of a deck an hour before it lands in a Fortune 500 room, rebuilding a landing page hero, redrawing a diagram until it explains itself, fixing the template so the mistake never happens again. You will do this daily, across every surface, and it is where your taste becomes the company's taste.

 - Own the bar on everything that ships. In practice that means daily hands-on work: an asset lifted from fine to excellent, a deck rebuilt, a crop fixed, a page tightened

 - Fix things at the source. When you correct something twice, the third fix goes into the template, the component, or the rule, so the whole system inherits it

 - Take the ad hoc work that keeps a fast company moving. When sales needs something tonight and the bench is busy, you build it, fast and at full quality, and enjoy that this is part of the job rather than an interruption to it

 - Make the references. The fastest way to communicate taste to a freelancer or an agent is an example you made yourself

 - Stay in the tools weekly. Figma, Framer, decks, motion direction, claude code, whatever the surface demands

3. TURN YOUR TASTE INTO A SYSTEM THAT SCALES THROUGH PEOPLE AND AI AGENTS

This is the multiplier, and the part of the role that makes it new. Your eye, encoded, executed by humans and machines.

 - Build and maintain the marketing design system: tokens, components, templates, asset library, usage rules

 - Encode the rules so agents can execute them: prompts, skills, and machine-readable guidelines for Claude and Claude Code, so on-brand assets get produced without your hands on the file

 - Treat the system as a product with users: marketing, sales, agents, freelancers. Ship it, version it, improve it from how it gets used

 - Write briefs and rules precise enough that a freelancer you have never met, or an agent, returns something usable on the first pass

 - Measure yourself on leverage: how much on-bran

jobs.title: AI Automation Intern (Sustainability)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

The Opportunity

Join our global sustainability reporting team and help reinvent how we use technology and AI to bring greater transparency, efficiency, and accountability to ESG reporting. As stakeholder expectations and regulations evolve, we’re building the future of sustainability intelligence.

We’re looking for someone passionate about the intersection of tech and sustainability, who’s eager to simplify systems and data by developing digital-first tools. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced, global teams and wants to shape the next generation of ESG reporting.

Who You Are

You’re passionate about sustainability and innovation, always exploring how emerging tech—like AI—can drive real-world ESG impact. You enjoy coding, structuring data, and building automated solutions that solve complex problems.

You thrive in global, cross-functional teams, communicate inclusively, and navigate diverse work cultures with ease. Analytical and solution-oriented, you turn regulatory complexity into clear, tech-driven actions.

An entrepreneurial self-starter, you’re adaptable, results-focused, and eager to work on cutting-edge sustainability projects.

You’re a recent graduate with a background in tech, strategy, data, economics or sustainability, based in the Netherlands (with the right to work here), passionate about using technology to solve sustainability challenges—and ready to grow in an international, dynamic setting.

What you bring

 - Strong interest in sustainability, ESG reporting, and emerging regulations (e.g., CSRD, ESRS, ISSB). Experience in application or through studies is a plus.

 - Passion for technology and AI, with experience or interest in process automation, data integration, or reporting systems.

 - Experience with data analysis, coding, building AI bots, or automating systems is a plus.

 - Comfortable with systems such as G-suite, Microsoft Office, etc.

 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to distill complexity into clarity.

 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and present ideas to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - A self-starter mindset: proactive, adaptable, and comfortable navigating ambiguity.

 - Fluent in English; additional languages are a bonus.

 - Bachelor’s degree or higher.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page https://prosusbenefits.com/.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values https://www.prosus.com/the-prosus-way.

Don't wait for the future of infrastructure. Be part of it.

Teleport is the AI Infrastructure Identity Company. We're solving one of the hardest problems in security: giving every human, machine, workload, and AI agent a cryptographically secured identity, improving engineering velocity while maintaining security. We make trusted computing simple. This gives you the freedom, power, and autonomy to build and innovate with confidence.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we work with companies like Nasdaq, DoorDash, and Elastic to secure infrastructure for an AI world.

As a member of the Teleport Customer Solutions Team, you will be responsible for implementing, supporting, evangelizing, and expanding Teleport at our top customers throughout the entire customer lifecycle. As a Senior Field Engineer, you will be dedicated to proactively driving adoption so that our customers achieve the maximum value from all Teleport products and solutions.You will work directly with our customers to help design solution architecture, deploy and configure Teleport hands-on, relay implementation best practices, provide triage and debugging of technical issues, develop and maintain training programs, evangelize the solution to a wider customer organization, and plan and assist with an enterprise-wide organizational rollout of the Teleport solution. You will act as a customer champion within Teleport and provide and help prioritize product feedback by working with the Teleport product team. As a Senior Field Engineer, you will be the primary lead to identify and provide initial triage of technical blockers via shared chat, ticket, and meetings. As our company grows, and we launch new offerings, the requirements of this position may shift. You should be comfortable with change and have an interest in continually learning and advancing your skillset.

 

Who you are - To succeed at Teleport and take your career into the future, we are looking for people who are:

 - Security-minded: Working on the very fabric of the internet and providing infrastructure access to some of the world’s biggest companies means you need to think security-first. Our platform is the gatekeeper - The Wall. And winter is coming. We need to ensure we’re secure.

 - Business-savvy: We don’t code for coding's sake. We build for our customers. Designed by engineers for engineers, we understand their environment, challenges and needs better than anyone else. That means we have built a business that can support them by making the right choices that ensure we are in business for the long haul.

What You'll Bring

 - BSc or Master Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering or another related engineering field. 

 - 8+ years experience in customer-facing software onboarding, software services, solution architecting, or system administration roles.

 - Linux administration skills.

 - Hands-on experience with one of the major public cloud providers: AWS, GCP, Azure. Certifications are a plus.

 - A strong understanding of Kubernetes and prior hands-on experience. Certification with CKA or CKAD is a plus. 

 - Demonstrable experience with the following security principles and technologies: SSH, PKI, 2FA, SSO (SAML, OIDC), RBAC.

 - Exceptional hands-on software troubleshooting, testing, and debugging skills with a tenacity to identify and resolve the technical issue that may arise.

 - Outstanding soft skills, excellent verbal and written communication skills.

 - Project management experience and the ability to handle multiple clients simultaneously.

 - Strong organizational skills.

What You'll Be Doing

 - Deploy and configure Teleport in a customer environment as well as communicate implementation best practices to the customer.

jobs.title: Events and Experiences Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT KASTLE

Kastle is building the AI employee for banks. Our AI agents help financial institutions originate loans, process payments, and support customers through some of their most important financial decisions. We’ve processed more than $2 billion in transactions and raised a $24M Series A, with backing from Insight Partners and Y Combinator.

We’re building a global company, and bringing our customers and future customers together will be a major part of how we grow.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Kastle will run 50+ events across North America in 2027. We’re looking for an Events & Experiences Lead to own the program and make every event exceptional.

You’ll build experiences that senior banking and lending executives make time for, remember, and tell their peers about. From a private dinner for twelve to a major industry conference, you’ll own the idea, the audience, the execution, and the results.

You’ll work directly with our founders, sales team, and customers. This is a hands-on role for someone with excellent taste, operational discipline, and the energy to run an ambitious international calendar.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the global events calendar. Decide where we show up, what we host, and how each event supports our target accounts and markets. Manage overlapping schedules, budgets, and deadlines across regions.
 

 - Create experiences worth attending. Develop executive dinners, customer gatherings, roadshows, conference activations, and distinctive experiences that give people a compelling reason to join us.
 

 - Get the right people in the room. Partner with sales on account lists, personal invitations, outreach, and meeting bookings. Own registration and attendance.
 

 - Set the quality bar. Make thoughtful choices about venues, food, programming, design, and hospitality. Carry that standard through invitations, arrival, introductions, and departure.
 

 - Make customers central to the experience. Bring customers and prospects together for honest conversations. Prepare customer speakers and create space for people to learn from one another.
 

 - Run production from start to finish. Source venues, negotiate vendor agreements, manage agencies and local crews, coordinate shipping and travel, and own on-site execution.
 

 - Prepare for everything. Build detailed event schedules, brief every team member, rehearse presentations and demos, and have workable backup plans. Stay calm and make decisions when circumstances change.
 

 - Turn events into business. Agree on goals and follow-up owners before each event. Track target-account attendance, qualified meetings, opportunities created, deal progression, and spend.
 

 - Build a program that scales. Create repeatable formats, reliable vendor relationships, and clear operating processes. Review every event and use what you learn to improve the next one.
 

 - Extend the impact. Work with marketing to turn event conversations, customer stories, and approved photography and video into content that keeps reaching people afterward.

WHO YOU ARE

 - You’ve owned the work. You have 4+ years in B2B events field marketing, or experiential marketing specifically in a SaaS company, with examples of programs you personally delivered.
 

 - You have excellent taste. You can create an experience that feels distinctive and appropriate for a senior audience.
 

 - You’re exceptionally organized. You can manage dozens of moving parts across multiple events without losing details or deadlines.
 

 - You’re commercially minded. You understand how events build relationships and help enterprise sales teams win business.
 

 - You’re a natural host. You notice who needs an introduction, who has been left out, and what would make a guest feel welcome.
 

 - You’re resourceful and decisive. You negotiate well, hold vendors accountable, and solve problems quickly.
 

 - You take full ownership. You can build the plan, rally the team, and stay through the final breakdown.
 

 - You enjoy being in the field. You’re comfortable with frequent domestic and international travel and evening or weekend work around events.
 

Experience delivering international events, working with executive audiences, or building an events program at a growing technology company is especially valuable.

WHY JOIN KASTLE

 - Build Kastle’s global events and experiences program from an early stage.

 - Work directly with founders and leaders shaping the future of financial services.

 - Have meaningful creative ownership and clear responsibility for results.

 - Work with some of the most talented people on the planet. 

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan, health and wellness membership support, company meals, and team offsites. At Kastle, we’re building at the edge of AI - fast, focused, and with real ownership. Sprints and major launches move quickly, and we look for people who are energized by that pace. Our team typically works around 60 hours per week, beginning at 8:00 AM, with five days spent collaborating in person at our San Francisco office.

jobs.title: Compliance and Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
ABOUT KASTLE

Kastle is building the AI employee for banks. Our AI agents help financial institutions originate loans, process payments, and support customers through some of their most important financial decisions. We’ve processed more than $2 billion in transactions and raised a $24M Series A, with backing from Insight Partners and Y Combinator.

We’re building AI for environments where accuracy, reliability, and compliance matter every day.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Compliance Counsel to help build the regulatory foundation behind Kastle’s AI agents.

You’ll work directly with our founders, product and engineering teams, and customers to translate financial services regulations into practical product requirements, compliance tests, and operating controls. You’ll also handle commercial contract reviews and help customers understand how our agents fit into their compliance programs.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad ownership. You should be as comfortable writing a test case for a borrower interaction as you are redlining a customer agreement or discussing a regulatory question with a bank’s compliance team.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build our AI compliance program. Establish the policies, controls, review processes, and documentation that support responsible deployment of AI agents across consumer lending, commercial lending, and banking workflows.

 - Turn regulations into test cases. Work with product and engineering to define compliant agent behavior, build realistic testing scenarios, set clear pass/fail criteria, and investigate failures before and after deployment.

 - Own our compliance library. Maintain a current, usable source of regulatory requirements and interpretations. Track changes in laws, rules, and regulatory guidance, and turn them into updates to our products, tests, and customer guidance.

 - Advise product development. Review agent scripts, disclosures, communication flows, and new capabilities. Identify risks early and help the team find practical ways to ship.

 - Work directly with customers. Partner with bank and lender legal and compliance teams on deployment reviews, control requirements, and ongoing compliance questions.

 - Review and negotiate contracts. Draft and redline customer and vendor agreements, including confidentiality, data protection, and compliance provisions. Coordinate specialized matters with outside counsel.

 - Shape our compliance positioning. Help sales and leadership explain our controls accurately in customer conversations, diligence responses, and external materials.

jobs.description:
Why We Exist

Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

 

Jerry.ai http://Jerry.ai is building the first app to manage it all. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. 

 

We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, scaled revenue 70X, and became profitable in early 2024. We're now expanding into adjacent verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, etc) to become the one-stop-shop for all your physical assets.

 

Why We’re Hiring

Our Business Operations & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

 

Every business unit has a Business Operations & Analytics team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years. 

 

As our business continues to expand, there is growing demand for more Business Operations & Analytics team members. We are hiring 2-3 people to drive impact in these areas:

 - Growth Marketing 

 - Product Development

 - AI & Automation

 - Strategic Partnerships 

 

On leveling: You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.

 

Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

 - No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc. 

 - No corporate fluff: The Business Operations & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals. 

 - Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end. 

 

What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central Business Operations & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.

 - Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.

 - Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.

 - Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.

 

Who You Are

 - First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?" 

 - Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.

 - Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

 

What You'll Bring

 - 2+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.

 - Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.

 - Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.

 - Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

 

Our Tools

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

 
 

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

What You'll Own
