jobs.title: Operations Specialist (Part-Time/Full-Time)
jobs.description:
Location: Dublin office · In-person

Hours: Part-time, 4 hours a day or full-time (9:00-6:00pm).

ABOUT SOLIDROAD

Building something great is addictive. It’s like discovering your favorite TV show mid-season, except you're helping write the next episode. It’s like unboxing a new gadget, except you’re the one designing it. You shape how it feels, how it works, and how people react when they use it.

At Solidroad we're solving a big, messy, exciting problem: how do you scale your customer teams without losing what makes humans amazing? Warmth, empathy, intuition. We’re using AI, generative tech, and real-time simulations to make this happen. It's ambitious, difficult, and genuinely new.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Solidroad is a fast-growing startup and our Dublin office moves quickly. We're looking for a part-time or full-time Operations Specialist to help keep things running day to day- taking care of the traveling, scheduling, event planning, ordering, and general errands that keep an office humming. It's a hands-on, varied role and a great way to get real exposure to how a high-growth startup operates from the inside.

This is perfect for someone looking to get stuck in, and learn the ops side of a startup.

WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO DAY-TO-DAY

 - Handle day-to-day office errands and operational tasks as they come up

 - Help coordinate team socials, office events

 - Keep the office stocked and tidy: order and restock supplies, snacks, drinks, and equipment

 - Book and schedule things- meetings, meeting rooms, travel, deliveries, and appointments

 - Manage incoming and outgoing post and deliveries

 - Be the day-to-day point of contact for office suppliers, vendors, and building/facilities (maintenance, cleaning, repairs)

 - Greet and host visitors, candidates, guests so they have a great first impression

 - Pitch in on ad hoc admin and ops tasks across the office

OUR TEAM & CULTURE

We're a small, focused group working full-time in our Dublin & San Francisco offices. We're here five days a week because building something ambitious means collaborating closely, solving problems together, sharing ideas spontaneously. We're intentional about creating a culture that's mature, supportive, and fun. You'll be joining experienced founders who've done this before, alongside a tight-knit team genuinely excited about building something impactful.

WE HOPE YOU

 - Have 2+ years of experience in operations, office management, or a similar role, ideally in a fast-growing company.

 - Are exceptionally organized and detail-oriented — you keep things running smoothly and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

 - Are naturally proactive — you spot problems before they happen, take initiative, and get things done without being asked.

 - Thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days look the same and priorities can change quickly.

 - Are a natural people person — friendly, approachable, and someone the whole team enjoys working with.

 - Take real ownership of your work, whether it's managing the office, organizing events, or supporting the wider team.

 - Are resourceful and solutions-oriented — you figure things out, even when there's no playbook to follow.

 - Think like a founder — you care about the little details, take pride in creating a great place to work, and are excited to help build something special.

 - Are based in Dublin and excited to be a hands-on presence in our office.

THE GOOD, THE BAD, AND THE HONEST TRUTH

The highs are real: you’ll play a big part in shaping the culture of a fast-growing startup, work closely with the leaders, and help create an office where people genuinely love coming to work. You’ll have the freedom to take ownership, bring new ideas to life, and make a real impact on how we operate day to day.

The lows? Things move fast, priorities change, and sometimes you’ll need to figure things out without a playbook. You’ll juggle everything from the little details to big team initiatives, and no two days will look the same. This isn’t a place to sit back and wait for instructions — it’s a place to take initiative, solve problems, and grow with the company.

If that sounds exciting, don’t overthink it. Reach out. Tell us a little about yourself, what you've done, and why you'd be great at making Solidroad an amazing place to work. We care more about attitude, initiative, and a willingness to get stuck in than a perfect CV.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews. 

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures. 

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people. 

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

This analyst turns Outset's own data into decisions faster than a traditional analytics hire would, by using AI tools as a core part of the workflow rather than bolting them on afterward. They're as comfortable writing a SQL query to understand critical business data accurately, as they are building a small internal tool, script, or AI skill that answers a recurring question without a human re-running it every week. 

The job is part analysis, part automation - someone who'd rather build the dashboard-that-builds-itself than ship the same report by hand twice. Improving processes and workflows across the company excites them and they love to build tools to help internal teams across the business move, manage and understand data.

Responsibilities

 - Answer recurring business questions across GTM, People, Product and Engineering using SQL, Python, and whatever AI tooling gets there fastest.

 - Build small internal tools - vibe coded apps, Slack bots, scripts, lightweight dashboards, AI skills - that eliminate a manual report or a repeated ad hoc request.

 - Partner with stakeholders to figure out what they actually need before building anything.

 - Maintain and improve data pipelines so the underlying numbers are trustworthy, not just the tools on top of them.

 - Evaluate new AI tools and workflows as they come out, and decide which are actually worth adopting internally vs. hype.

 - Document what you build well enough that someone else can run it without you in the room.

 - Flag data quality issues and inconsistent definitions before they turn into bad decisions.

Qualifications

 - 3+ years in a data analyst, analytics engineer, or BI role, with real SQL and Python fluency.

 - Hands-on experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Cursor, or similar) to build something real - a script, an agent, an automation - not just to summarize text.

 - A builder's instinct: when a manual process repeats twice, the next step is automating it, not doing it a third time.

 - Able to go from a vague stakeholder ask to a specific, well-scoped answer without heavy hand-holding.

 - Clear written communication - can explain a finding or a tool to someone non-technical in a few sentences.

 - Experience at a startup where the data stack and tooling were still being built, not inherited mature.

 - Exposure to building or prompting AI agents/workflows (not just using chat interfaces).

 - Familiarity with modern BI/data tools (dbt, Looker, Hex, or similar).

jobs.title: Founding Recruiter
jobs.description:
ABOUT PROSPER AI

Prosper is building the most advanced conversational AI agents for healthcare, human-like phone agents that handle the administrative work draining the system, including claims status checks, benefit verification, prior authorizations, patient scheduling, and balance reminders. Our mission is to eliminate $200B in administrative waste so healthcare professionals can focus more on healing and less on paperwork.

 

Headquartered in New York with an office in Barcelona, we work with dozens of large and enterprise healthcare organizations and have raised $30M from top investors including a16z, Base10, YC, and Emergence. We're a highly motivated team of 70, including ex-MIT, HBS, Bain, and Math/CS/Physics olympiad medalists. As we prepare for our next stage of growth, we're looking for ambitious, exceptionally talented people to help scale our team and grow with us.

 

THE ROLE

We're experiencing rapid growth in New York and Barcelona, and hiring well is now one of the most important things we do. As our first dedicated Recruiter, you’ll own our searches from the first conversation with the hiring manager through to the signed offer.

 

This is a hands-on role with true ownership. Beyond your own searches, you'll help us build and refine our hiring processes as we scale, from interviews to the data we use for improvement.

 

You’ll report to our Head of People and work closely with hiring managers and founders. This role is based in our Barcelona office, with at least three days a week in person.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Run searches end to end: kick-off with the hiring manager, sourcing, screening, interviews, offers, and closing

 - Source directly and build strong pipelines of passive candidates; the majority of your hires will come from your outreach

 - Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, assessment strategies, and candidate profiles

 - Ensure every candidate experiences a fast, clear, and respectful process; everyone hears back from us

 - Keep Ashby updated and report on pipeline health, time to hire, and conversions for each search

 - Continuously improve our processes: interview guides, scorecards, outreach templates, and our presence in the Barcelona tech community

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting, ideally in-house at a fast-growing tech startup

 - Demonstrated experience hiring engineers, with examples of searches you've led from kick-off to signed offer

 - Strong sourcing skills: you excel at finding and attracting passive candidates

 - Able to manage multiple searches simultaneously with excellent follow-through; hiring managers and candidates never chase you for updates

 - Provide hiring managers with a clear, data-backed point of view, and aren’t afraid to challenge ineffective processes or profiles

 - Fluent English, both written and spoken; you’ll work with teams and candidates across Europe and the US

 

NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience recruiting for AI, healthcare, or SaaS companies

 - Go-to-market hiring (sales, customer success) as well as engineering

 - Experience with Ashby or other modern ATS

 - Spanish proficiency

 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Hiring managers view you as a trusted partner and value your candidate assessments

 - The majority of hires come through your proactive sourcing

 - Candidates rate their experience highly, even those not selected

 - Reduced time from kick-off to signed offer, supported by clear data

 

WHY PROSPER

 - Work on products that transform US healthcare operations, at the forefront of conversational AI

 - Real ownership and impact from day one, alongside a talented and driven team

 - Significant professional growth opportunities as the company scales

 - Join an international team across New York and Barcelona

 - A culture that rewards bold thinking, analytical rigor, and tangible results

 - Shape Prosper’s hiring approach as our first dedicated recruiter

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Initial conversation to understand your background, goals, and interests (30 minutes)

 2. Written exercise at home on managing one of our real searches (around 2 hours)

 3. Live session with our Head of People and a hiring manager: review your exercise and run a mock kick-off meeting (45 minutes)

 4. Conversation with a co-founder (30 minutes)

 5. Offer stage

 

Prosper AI is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews. 

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures. 

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people. 

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We're looking for an experienced product designer to join our small team and own meaningful parts of the Outset product. A significant part of your purview will be our Digital Twins / Simulations Lab—a new 0→1 product we're building alongside the core platform—though the work will reach across the product as the team's needs evolve.

Simulations are deep tech. Underneath the product are models, data pipelines, and research methods built by our scientists, and presenting a complex product with simplicity and intuitiveness is critical. You'll need to be curious about what's happening under the hood, patient enough to understand it, and sharp enough to translate it into product experiences that a researcher can grasp quickly.

You'll work closely with our Head of Design, PMs, Sales, and Engineering to understand what we're building and how we're selling it, and to make sure the product reflects both.

Newer parts of the product, Simulations especially, are being actively shaped by customer feedback and competitive dynamics. We're looking for someone who holds a high bar for craft without being precious about their own work as we iterate.

So much has changed about what it means to do "design work." The toolkit has expanded to include tools like Codex and Claude Design, and our team spends as much time generating and molding prototypes as organizing canvases in Figma. Technical fluency is a major plus here, but strong opinions, taste, and a track record of shipping are what matter most.

You'll join a small design team and own projects from the kernel of an idea to a feature customers use every day, working directly with our founders and, on simulations work, the scientists building the lab.

Responsibilities

 - Own product surfaces end to end. Take projects from early concepts through launch and iteration, including a central role in our Simulations work.

 - Simplify technical complexity. Dig into how our simulations and other systems actually work, then design experiences that make the output legible and trustworthy to researchers.

 - Stay close to customers. Sit in on customer conversations, read the feedback, and turn it into design decisions quickly.

 - Hold a high bar for craft. Produce wireframes, interaction designs and high-fidelity visuals, and sweat the details in the shipped product.

 - Know what not to build. Question features that add complexity without adding much value, and help the team cut scope down to what matters most.

Qualifications

 - We don't have many explicit requirements, and exceptional candidates might bend these rules.

 - 5+ years of product design industry experience, ideally including time as the lead or founding designer on a product or major product area.

 - Experience taking a product from 0 to 1, or working in an early-stage environment where the direction changed often.

 - Genuine curiosity about technically complex systems, and a track record of designing clear products on top of them.

 - Comfort working directly with customers and treating their feedback as a primary input to design.

 - Exceptional communication skills.

 - Strong but loosely held opinions on design and product.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Comfort designing in code—building prototypes with real data, or shipping frontend changes alongside engineers.

 - Experience building enterprise software.

 - Experience building in the research industry.

You’ll work closely across the GTM teams, deploy internal tooling with AI, turn Attio into our source of truth, and build an intelligent GTM motion on top.

This is an IC role, not a people management role. One week you might be rolling your sleeves up with the growth team, to be one or two steps ahead in identifying what the team need to hit their targets, and building internal tooling with AI to support the team. The next week you might be deep in the data, bringing company-wide data sources together to aide growth strategy planning e.g. identifying high demand areas in our marketplace, where we need to increase supply.

OBJECTIVE 1: KEEP SYSTEMS AND DATA RUNNING AT A HIGH STANDARD

You will own and maintain Attio (our CRM), including its infrastructure, workflows and data hygiene across accounts and products. You will also own all our GTM tooling (e.g. Aircall, Calendly, Granola) and keep them running and improving. You will build a lot of tooling yourself using AI (e.g. dashboard, maps). You will run practice enrichment and data scraping pipelines so our data on customers stays current and usable.

OBJECTIVE 2: GIVE THE TEAM AND LEADERSHIP CLEAR VISIBILITY

You will build and maintain dashboards tracking company growth, cycle targets and product adoption. You will own reporting on practice numbers and growth trends. You will maintain tracking so leadership always has clear visibility on where deals are at.

OBJECTIVE 3: ENABLE THE GROWTH TEAM TO SELL MORE

The Growth team are your customer. You will build and maintain quality lead lists for AEs. You will support AEs with operational queries, targets and tooling. You will help new growth hires ramp faster through better tooling and playbooks.

OBJECTIVE 4: DRIVE OPERATIONAL IMPROVEMENT

You will find and build automations and workflow improvements that save the team time. You will spot friction in how the growth team operates and fix it. You will actively look for ways to help the team drive more revenue.

⚠️ THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR EVERYONE

This is a high-ownership, high-expectation role. You'll be working in a fast-moving healthtech environment where accuracy, speed, and proactivity all matter at the same time.

You probably won't enjoy this role if you:

 - Prefer to be told what to do over figuring out what to do

 - Treat ops as a support function rather than a growth lever

 - Aren't comfortable getting your hands dirty with data

 - Are content to maintain the status quo rather than improve it

 - Have never built things with AI

You will enjoy this role if you like owning systems end-to-end, building and deploying things with AI, and making the people around you more effective.

👍 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

 - 2+ years in a revenue operations role in an early-stage startup, where you've owned systems, data and process improvement

 - Experience with Attio (or similar CRMs like HubSpot, Salesforce)

✅ MUST-HAVE TRAITS

 - Great with AI - you know how to leverage AI well, whilst thoroughly checking accuracy

 - Detail oriented - you’re obsessed with the detail and CRM being the source of truth

 - Love data - you can build dashboards, spot trends, and make data useful for decision-making

 - Proactive problem solver - you don't wait for someone to flag a problem; you find it and fix it end-to-end.

 - Bias to action - you ship improvements quickly rather than over-planning

 - Team player - low ego, approachable and feedback-oriented; you get a kick from seeing the impact your work has on unlocking the sales team

 - Clear communicator - you keep stakeholders informed without being chased

💙 DESIRED TRAITS

 - Comfortable with data scraping, enrichment tools and light automation (e.g. Zapier, Make, scripts)

 - Experience building dashboards and reports (e.g. Metabase, Looker, Google Sheets)

 - Familiarity with sales tooling (Calendly, Aircall, or equivalents)

 - Experience writing operational playbooks or onboarding materials

😊 THE HIRING PROCESS (4 STAGES)

 - 👋 Intro chat - with our Talent Partner, to learn more about each other

 - 🤿 CV & work experience deep dive - with our hiri

jobs.title: Strategic Sales Director
jobs.description:
WHAT WE ARE BUILDING AT CONVEO

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high-quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing and product teams.

#1 What problem are we solving, and why is this an important problem to solve

The current/traditional research methods companies rely on are slow, expensive, and superficial. Running great research also requires expertise, which is a blocker to many companies. That directly affects how well companies understand their customers and how well they can serve them.

#2 The team you will join

You will join an extremely talented team of incredibly passionate, high-energy people. We go the extra mile while having the best time of our lives. Our team has the combination of decades of market research knowledge, incredible engineering ability, and experience building companies.

#3 How we operate

 - We truly care about our clients and the problem we solve. That means we humbly go the extra mile every time.

 - We work hard, and we have fun.

 - To keep our quality bar incredibly high, we want to execute with the smallest possible team.

THE ROLE

As a Strategic Sales Director at Conveo, you'll own a focused book of the world's largest brands and turn them into our biggest partnerships. You'll land new strategic logos and grow them from first study into multi-market, multi-year programmes worth seven figures. You'll sell beyond the research team, into CMOs, product leaders, and the C-suite, positioning Conveo as the customer knowledge layer for the whole organisation. You'll work hand in hand with the founders, Customer Success, and Product on deals from $250K up to seven figures, with long, complex sales cycles. You’ll report to our EMEA Head of Revenue.

YOUR MISSION

Land the World's Biggest Brands

 - Own a named list of strategic Fortune 500 accounts across CPG, Pharma, Tech, and Financial Services.

 - Build deep account plans: org maps, budget holders, strategic priorities, and entry points.

 - Multi-thread from day one across insights, marketing, product, procurement, and the executive suite.

 - Build and maintain 4-5x pipeline coverage on your book.

Expand Accounts Into $5M+ Partnerships

 - Grow initial wins across brands, markets, and business units into multi-year agreements.

 - Move the conversation from single studies to always-on research and an enterprise-wide knowledge layer.

 - Partner with Customer Success to turn every early project into a proof point for the next budget holder.

 - Run executive business reviews that tie Conveo to the customer's commercial outcomes.

Run Complex, Executive-Level Deals

 - Lead consultative discovery and build compelling business cases and ROI tied to the customer's KPIs.

 - Navigate large buying committees (economic buyer, users, procurement, legal, InfoSec) and own the mutual close plan.

 - Negotiate and close clean, scalable enterprise contracts.

 - Bring in founders and senior leaders at the right moments to win.

Be the Market & Product Expert

 - Know the insights, marketing, and product world inside out, and speak the language of each buyer.

 - Stay on top of competitor moves and market trends to sharpen messaging and win bake-offs.

 - Provide structured feedback to shape roadmap priorities for enterprise customers.

 - Maintain crisp CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - New strategic logos landed, with clear paths to $5M+ in annual value.

 - Existing accounts expanded into multi-market, multi-year agreements with rising ACV and ARR.

 - Executive relationships (CMO, CPO, C-suite) in every account in your book.

 - Accurate forecasts and healthy 4-5x pipeline coverage, quarter after quarter.

 - Referenceable flagship customers and repeatable strategic plays we can roll out across the team.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 10+ years of enterprise sales in Enterprise SaaS or Martech, with a focus on strategic or named accounts.

 - Track record of closing and expanding complex, multi-stakeholder deals ($500K+ ACV, up to seven figures) with long sales cycles.

 - Experience selling to and growing Fortune 500 accounts, including at C-suite level.

 - Great if you have a strong network or background in market research, insights, brand, or consulting.

 - High energy, self-motivation, and a relentless drive to win.

 - Excellent communication skills: active listener, persuasive storyteller, and trusted advisor to senior executives.

 - Comfortable with CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce) and structured deal methodologies (MEDDIC or similar).

 - Team player who thrives in a fast-paced, low-politics, high-standards environment.

WHY JOIN US

At Conveo, you'll join a team that genuinely enjoys working and spending time together. We care about building real relationships, not just great products. That's why we run quarterly team off-sites where we disconnect, reset, and have fun.

Plus

 - Own a high-impact role at a hyper-growth, YC-backed AI company.

 - Direct access to founders and high-leverage operators.

 - Sell to and grow some of the world's most iconic brands.

 - Help define how AI-powered research becomes the global default.

 - Competitive compensation with meaningful equity upside.

 - A culture built on taste, speed, ownership, and ambition.

 - Opportunities to travel globally and build real relationships with customers shaping the future.

jobs.title: Admin Clerk (A/P)
jobs.description:
Ready to make an impact? At Hive Health http://ourhivehealth.com, we’re on a mission to make healthcare radically more accessible for all—and we need passionate, driven individuals to help us make it happen. If you thrive in a fast-paced, innovative environment and want to work on solutions that truly matter, we’d love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Admin Clerk, you will support the Accounting Team by assisting the Accounts Payable (A/P) function. This role provides an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in financial operations, enhance your accounting skills, and contribute to the smooth flow of financial processes within the company.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Compliance and Reporting:

QUALIFICATIONS

 - Proficiency in accounting software, spreadsheets, and PH compliance.

 - High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple deadlines.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

 - Must be willing to work onsite in Ortigas, Pasig

Join our team as we revolutionalize healthcare in the Philippines—and beyond!

🚀 Grow with us – mentorship, career development, and learning opportunities to help you thrive.
🌍 Global connections – gain insights and support from top minds at Harvard, Stanford, and beyond.

jobs.title: Deal Desk Coordinator (Contract)
jobs.description:
ABOUT RETELL AI

Retell AI is using first-principles thinking to reimagine the call center with cutting-edge voice AI. Thousands of companies now use Retell's AI voice agents to handle sales, support, and logistics calls that once required large teams of human agents. Backed by Y Combinator, Alt Capital, and other leading investors, we've scaled to $80M in ARR with a team of 50, up from $5M at the start of 2025, and are now valued at over $1.5B.

Our vision for 2026 is to build a modern CX platform where entire contact centers are powered by AI. Instead of basic automation that needs constant human tuning, we're creating intelligent AI “workers” that act as frontline agents, QA analysts, and managers, continuously executing, monitoring, and improving every customer interaction.

We're growing fast and looking for ambitious builders who want to tackle hard technical problems, move quickly, and have a real impact on one of the fastest-growing voice AI companies in the world.

Let's build the future together.

Recent recognition:

 - No. 1 Best Places to Work in the Bay Area, San Francisco Business Times 2026 https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/voice-ai-startup-retell-ai-145200025.html

 - Top 50 AI Apps, a16z (2025) https://a16z.com/the-ai-application-spending-report-where-startup-dollars-really-go/

 - #3 Fastest-Growing Software Company, G2 Best Software Awards 2026 https://company.g2.com/news/g2s-2026-best-software-awards

 - Best Agentic AI Software, G2 Best Software Awards 2026 https://www.retellai.com/blog/retell-ai-recognized-as-the-best-agentic-ai-software-by-g2

 - #4 Fastest-Growing Software Vendor, Brex Benchmark 2025 https://www.brex.com/journal/brex-benchmark-december-2025

 - Enterprise Tech 30 Class of 2026, Nasdaq & Wing VC https://www.nasdaq.com/videos/retell-ai

 - Top-Ranked Startup, Lean AI Leaderboard https://leanaileaderboard.com/

 - Backed by Y Combinator https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/retell-ai

ABOUT THE ROLE

Retell AI transforms customer experience with voice AI for enterprises, including customers like CVS/Aetna, American Airlines, Lenovo, and Grab. We have more customer stories than we can tell!

We’re hiring our a Deal Desk Coordinator on a 1099 contract to work on deals. You’ll work directly with the founder and daily with Sales, Finance, and Legal. Our usage-based pricing is still taking shape, and the deals you structure will shape it.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

This role has fast, profitable deal approvals from quote to cash.

 - Structure and approve non-standard deals (discounts, usage commits, per-minute pricing, payment terms) in hours, not days

 - Build the discount approval matrix and pricing guardrails, and model deal margin before every approval

 - Run quote-to-cash across CRM, CPQ, Legal handoff, and billing

 - Report weekly on cycle time, discount levels, and win rate, and automate approvals where possible

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Must have:

 - 4+ years in deal desk, pricing, or sales/revenue operations at a B2B SaaS company

 - Experience owning an end-to-end enterprise process for deals

 - Hands-on experience with Salesforce or HubSpot and a CPQ tool

 - Experience at a VC-backed SaaS/AI company or a big tech/large SaaS company

 - Availability for overlapping hours with our Pacific Time team and customers

Nice to have:

 - Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing

 - Built a deal desk function from scratch

 - SQL or scripting skills to automate reporting and approvals

HOW WE EVALUATE

We care less about checkboxes and more about:

 - Commercial judgment on real deal scenarios

 - Accuracy in pricing and margin models

 - Calm, clear decisions under end-of-quarter pressure

 - Ability to influence Sales, Finance, and Legal

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IF

 - You’d rather say “here’s how we can do it” than “no”

 - You enjoy a spreadsheet model as much as a live deal call

 - You want to build the playbook, not follow one

JOB DETAILS

 - Employment Type: Full-Time 1099 Contractor

 - Compensation: $4,200 USD monthly, based on experience

 - Location: Remote

 - Hours: Must be open to working some overlapping hours with our Pacific Time team and customers.

jobs.title: Content Marketer
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

You'll script, shoot and edit content clinic owners actually watch.

Your job is simple: get clinic owners to stop, watch, and want to talk to us.

That means turning what we're building, what our clinics are achieving, and what's changing in aesthetics and wellness into content people actually want to watch.

You'll script it, shoot it, edit it, post it, then look hard at what happened so the next piece is better.

Content is the core of this job, and most of your week.

The rest is helping Decoda show up everywhere else clinic owners are paying attention: industry conferences, press, and the moments that put us in front of the right people.

You'll get to know how clinic owners think, what frustrates them, and what makes them hit follow.

You'll use that to make content that feels like it was made for them, not for an algorithm.

When clinic owners are sharing our content, our ads are pulling in demos, and sales calls start with "I saw your video," you'll know you're doing great work.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Ship every week. We move fast and our content should too. You'll publish multiple pieces of short form video and social content every week across multiple channels. Live and learning beats perfect and sitting in drafts.

Make ads that earn the click. You'll build the creative behind our paid social: the hooks, the angles, the variants. You'll test them, read the results, and work with the team to scale what works and cut what doesn't. A good ad isn't one that looks nice; it's one that brings in clinics.

Turn what we build into stories. We ship products quickly, and you'll make sure the market feels it. When something launches, you'll turn demos and founder takes into content that makes clinic owners want it. A launch isn't real to the market until someone has made it worth watching.

Put our customers on camera. Hundreds of clinics run on Decoda, and their results are our best marketing. You'll find the stories worth telling and make them worth watching.

Know what's working. You'll track performance every week and form your own point of view from the numbers. Instinct gets you started; data tells you where to go next.

Own the calendar. You'll plan content around launches, customer wins and industry moments so we're never scrambling for what to post next.

Make Decoda show up in the room. You'll help us prepare for and run industry conferences, from booth content and materials to capturing everything on the ground. You'll also help pitch stories, support PR moments, and make sure every launch and customer win gets seen beyond our own channels. An event isn't done when the booth comes down; it's done when the content from it is live and working.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - A portfolio of content real people watched. Share it with your application

 - 1 to 3 years making content for a brand, startup or agency

 - Range. You can write the script, hold the camera, and cut the edit

 - Comfort on camera, or the willingness to get there fast

 - Experience with paid social creative, or a real hunger to learn how performance creative works

 - You check what worked and adjust

 - A bias for shipping. You publish, take feedback, and get better quickly

 - You're up for a mix. You'll go from editing a reel to packing for a conference to drafting a press pitch in the same week

 - You want to work hard. This is a small team moving fast, and the pace is high on purpose

 - Experience in aesthetics, wellness or healthcare is a plus, not a requirement

LOGISTICS

This role is based in Toronto and is in person. Some travel for conferences.

jobs.title: Office Manager & Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
ABOUT SYGALDRY

Sygaldry Technologies is building quantum-accelerated AI servers to exponentially speed up training and inference. Our AI servers address the problem of rising compute and energy costs for scaling AI, enabling companies to innovate faster and more affordably. We're building the infrastructure for quantum super intelligence.

We pioneer new domains in physics, engineering, and AI, tackling the hardest challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture. Our team is growing — we're looking for people who want to shape how quantum and AI intersect, and unlock the potential of both together.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Sygaldry is seeking an organized, dependable, and proactive Office Manager & Executive Assistant to support the daily operations of our Ann Arbor office and provide administrative support to company executives.

This person will help keep the office organized, stocked, and welcoming while coordinating schedules, travel, meetings, and day-to-day administrative needs. The ideal candidate enjoys helping others, takes initiative, and is comfortable balancing hands-on office tasks with executive support.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Office Support

 - Own the day-to-day operations of the office and ensure it is organized, welcoming, and running smoothly

 - Keep the office stocked, and ready for use, including meeting rooms, kitchen, shared spaces and supply areas.

 - Receive, sort, and distribute mail, packages, and deliveries, notifying employees promptly of time-sensitive arrivals.

 - Order and coordinate food and beverages for team lunches, meetings, visitors, and office events.

 - Handle setup and breakdown for lunches, meetings, and events.

 - Welcome visitors and help coordinate their on-site experience.

 - Assist with vendor appointments, office projects, workspace changes, and new employee workstation setup.

 - Maintain basic office inventories, checklists, receipts, and order records.

 - Identify office or facilities needs and communicate them promptly.

Executive & Administrative Support

 - Provide day-to-day administrative and operational support to Co-founder

 - Manage calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination across internal and external stakeholders

 - Coordinate domestic and international travel, including flights, hotels, ground transportation, and itineraries

 - Help executives prioritize their time by proactively identifying scheduling conflicts, dependencies, and follow-ups

 - Coordinate meetings, including logistics, materials, and other preparation as needed

 - Handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and sound judgment

 - Anticipate needs and proactively solve problems before they become blockers

QUALIFICATIONS

 - Previous experience in administrative support, executive assistance, office operations, hospitality, or events is preferred.

 - Organized and attentive to detail, with strong follow-through.

 - Proactive, dependable, and comfortable with hands-on tasks.

 - Warm and professional communication style.

 - Able to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing schedules in a fast-moving environment.

 - Comfortable coordinating calendars, travel arrangements, and meeting logistics.

 - Proficient with Google Workspace and comfortable using Slack and other common workplace tools.

 - Sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive information.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

 - Ability to move throughout the office and assist with routine meeting and event setup.

 - Ability to occasionally move or lift office supplies, packages, food orders, and event materials, with reasonable accommodations available as needed.

HOW WE’RE DIFFERENT

At Sygaldry, curiosity and intellectual courage drive our work. We approach ambitious challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture and know that kind people build the strongest teams. We prioritize mission over ego and collaborate openly with a strong sense of shared purpose. We dream big, yet we execute with a love of detail. We’re looking for scientists, engineers, and operators to forge new paths with us at the intersection of quantum and AI.

CULTURE & BENEFITS

We lean into thoughtful use of agentic AI tools. Claude Code, Codex, and AI-assisted workflows are part of daily operations across the team, and we expect this role to benefit from these tools too. How you explore, assess, and leverage emerging AI tools is something we actively value.

 - Compensation - We value your contribution and invest in your future with a competitive salary and meaningful equity.

 - Benefits - Your well-being matters. We provide company-sponsored health coverage to give you and your family peace of mind.

 - Connection - Whether it’s company offsite or casual crew socials, we make time to connect, recharge, and have fun together.

 - Time Off - We trust you to take the time you need. Unlimited PTO so you can rest, recharge, and come back ready to make an impact.

We encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. If you don’t think this role is right for you, but you believe that you would have something meaningful to to contribute to our mission, please reach out at [email in original advert].

Location: This position will be based on-site in our Ann Arbor, MI office.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
ABOUT HAPPYROBOT

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. About the Role

jobs.title: Research Scientist
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews. 

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures. 

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people. 

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

Outset builds digital twins: AI systems that represent specific real people and respond to research questions the way those people would. The Digital Twins Team runs an ongoing research program to measure and improve how faithfully these systems reproduce human responses and behavior, across a range of cross-sectional levels of analysis.

The Research Scientist works directly with and reports to the Head Scientist. Together you will choose what to study, design the studies, define how results are measured, interpret the findings, and write them up for internal decision-making and, where appropriate, for academic publication. You will bring current methodological training in computational social science, data science, survey-methodology, human-computation interaction, and experiment design.

Responsibilities 

 - Co-design and run studies that compare system-generated responses with responses from humans, using both qualitative and quantitative measures.

 - Design, justify, and hone measures of performance.

 - Apply and adapt state-of-the-art statistical techniques common to survey methodology and large-scale social data analysis, to benchmark and improve sample- and population-level simulation performance.

 - Design evaluations and experiments with pre-specified analysis plans.

 - Design and oversee human rating studies, including rater training, coding rubrics, and inter-rater agreement measurement.

 - Design data collection from third-party data sources and directly from human participants, including longitudinal and repeated-measures studies.

 - Contribute to the research agenda for new modeling approaches, including evaluation of fine-tuned models and of model calibration.

 - Specify analyses precisely enough for an engineer to implement.

 - Co-author papers, preprints, and presentations.

Qualifications

 - A completed or nearly completed PhD in computational social science, communication, HCI, sociology, political science, psychology, statistics, or a related field.

 - Peer-reviewed publications on which you were a primary author.

 - Working command of graduate-level statistical methodology common to social science, including the assumptions behind each.

 - Experience analyzing large-scale telemetry and behavioral datasets, with attention to the validity of the resulting inference.

 - Familiarity with machine learning, spanning classical, nonparametric, and LLM-based approaches, including how transformer-based language models work, what fine-tuning does, and how the major model families differ.

 - Fundamentals of computing: file systems, software libraries, databases, SQL, and tabular data.

 - Ability to work in an environment where most code is produced through agentic coding tools, and to read and check that code.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience fine-tuning open-weight language models on survey, experimental, or behavioral data.

 - Experience building or evaluating calibrated confidence or error-prediction models, including deriving decision thresholds from human judgments.

 - Experience measuring similarity of open-ended text, for example with embedding-based methods.

 - Experience designing or running panel-based data collection with human participants.

 - Experience presenting research at academic and/or industry conferences.

 - Prior work on generative agents, digital twins, or simulation of human respondents.

 - Familiarity with the startup ecosystem

 - Familiarity with qualitative interviews and ethnographic methods

 - Familiarity with topics in computational linguistics

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Insurance is one of the largest industries in the world, and it still runs on manual work nobody wants to do. Claims is the clearest case: high-volume, repetitive workflows handled over the phone, by email, and across 200-page PDFs, most of it sitting in systems built in the early 2000s. Software has circled this problem for decades without touching the core of it, because nothing could make the calls or read the documents. AI finally can. Avallon builds agents that run the full claims lifecycle, from intake to settlement, so teams can move faster, eliminate busywork, and get more right.

Out of YC we went from zero to seven figures of ARR in twelve months, and are now growing 3X quarter over quarter while working with some of the largest carriers in the world. Avallon is backed by top investors, and our founding team includes builders from MIT, Harvard, and Cornell. We aim to become the automation layer for the entire insurance industry, and we intend to get there with a talent-dense team where everyone is enabled to do the best work of their careers. No one can predict the future of insurance, so we're building it.

THE ROLE

We're looking for an exceptional Product Engineer. You'll build the platform that lets insurance teams put AI to work on real operations, and trust it when it matters. Your job is to find what the platform needs next and build it.

Our forward-deployed engineers run customer deployments on top of the platform. You build the platform itself. Working closely with them, design, and customers, you'll spot the hard problems that keep coming up and turn them into product: the smallest version that creates value now and extends cleanly later.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Shape the product from the start. You come in early, working with customers, design, and product strategy to decide what gets built and why, not picking up tickets after the decisions are made.

 - Build the rails insurance will run on. From public chat interfaces where claimants report and follow their claims, to branded portals our largest carrier customers host on Avallon, you build the surfaces the industry will soon run on.

 - Help teams confidently automate more. Build clear, auditable claim context and the experiences that let people review and approve agent work, giving teams control where it matters and letting them expand automation with confidence.

 - Own it end to end, in production. Build the whole flow yourself, from data model to backend to interface, then own how it performs: instrument it, watch how real users move through it in Datadog RUM, and keep pushing it as more teams rely on it.

The work is broad, and your impact will grow wherever the platform needs you most. You will take on a meaningful challenge, ship it quickly, watch what changes in production, and go again.

YOU

 - You have 3+ years building and owning meaningful software in production. You can point to a difficult challenge you solved or a system you built that changed what was possible, explain the judgment behind it, and answer for the outcome once it was live.

 - You are a full-stack product engineer who builds whole flows yourself. TypeScript and SQL are your working tools; you design the data model and backend as readily as the interface on top of it. You work closely with design and product strategy, have opinions about what to build, and can explain them clearly. This is not a frontend-only role.

 - You have built and operated LLM- or agent-powered products in production, and understand the challenges of making them reliable at scale.

 - You want to be in the room. This role is in person in New York.
 
 

NICE TO HAVE

 - You know insurance, claims, or another regulated operational domain where reliability and traceability matter.

 - You have worked as a product manager, or owned product decisions and roadmap in a similar role.

 - You have worked at an early-stage company.

 - You have been a founder or founding engineer.

A FEW THINGS WE BELIEVE IN

 - Eating well: We provide lunch and dinner every workday from local restaurants.

 - Health & Wellness: Your health is on us. We cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums, offer up to $17,000 toward fertility and family-forming through Carrot, and give you a monthly gym stipend to stay active.

 - Getting out of the office together to recharge: quarterly offsites somewhere you actually want to go.

 - And our favorite: unlimited token budget. No caps, no rationing. Build with whatever makes you fastest.

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT FINNY

FINNY is a growth platform for financial advisors. We are on a mission to make great financial advice easier to find. Today, access to quality financial guidance is limited, not because advisors don't exist, but because the right connections are hard to make when it matters. We're fixing that with AI-powered tools that help advisors find, engage, and retain the clients they can genuinely help.

 

We've raised a $4.5M Seed from Y-Combinator in S24 and now $17M Series A led by Venrock. We work with over 1,000 firms across the wealth management ecosystem, and have been recognized as the leader in fintech innovation—winning #1 at the Morningstar Fintech Showcase, #1 at 2026 Wealthies, and being featured across the industry.

 

We're based in Chelsea, NYC, building fast and ambitious systems at the intersection of data, AI, and real-world wealth services.

 

ABOUT THE TEAM

 

You'll join FINNY Engineering and report to our VP of Engineering. The team today is product and backend engineers and a data team. You'll be our first analytics engineer, building the foundation of the company's analytics warehouse on dbt Core and Snowflake.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

 

FINNY is a metrics-driven company. Until now, our analytics warehouse has been a shared role, divided across several teams. We're bringing it together in a new structure, on a new foundation, and we're hiring a senior Analytics Engineer to own it end to end: the models, the definitions of the metrics the company runs on, and the reports people trust.

 

You'll work directly with operations, sales, marketing, growth strategy, finance, product and engineering. Success looks like: the metrics the company runs on have tested definitions, a small set of reports is the first place people look, AI tools answer questions about those metrics correctly, and every key business area is covered to the same standard. As the data team grows, you'll help hire and lead it.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the analytics warehouse day to day: staging and core models, dimensions, facts and identity resolution across our systems

 - Define the metrics FINNY runs on, with tests and documentation, so every team works from the same numbers

 - Partner with internal stakeholders across the company to turn their questions into models and reports they use

 - Own the BI layer: choose the tool and semantic layer, and keep a small set of authoritative reports

 - Make the warehouse something AI tools can answer from correctly

 - Run the dbt project like software: version control, code review, CI, tests and documentation

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Typically 4+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering or analytics, including owning models that other teams relied on

 - Strong SQL and dimensional modeling: facts, dimensions, conformed keys, and a clear grain for every table

 - dbt (or an equivalent tool) in production, with git, tests and CI

 - You've defined business metrics people used to make decisions, and fixed the cause when two numbers disagreed

 - You work directly with non-technical partners and turn vague questions into clear answers—and say "not yet" with a reason

 - Scrappy, with ownership: you jump in where help is needed, including work outside your job description

 - You're excited to work in person, 5 days a week, in our Chelsea, NYC office

 

NICE TO HAVE

 - First or early data hire at a startup

 - Modeled complex pricing, billing, subscription or usage data

 - Made data usable by AI agents: documentation, a semantic layer, guardrails

 - Event analytics (PostHog or similar) and CRM data

 

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

FINNY offers a competitive compensation package including:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - Flexible paid time off

 - 401(k)

 - Food and meals provided in our NYC office

 - Team offsites and events

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

FINNY is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise items with just a photo. Turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable and tradable global inventory layer.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally.

Fleek already owns the demand. Most of the live bets sell to buyers who transact on Fleek today, so they're a supply-first test rather than a two-sided cold start. Your job on a new bet is to find and onboard the supply, sell it into demand that already exists and read the economics fast.

Every bet runs through the same gates. If a bet misses its gates, you kill it with evidence and move to the next one. If it works and you're running it well, you don't have to hand it off. You scale into owning the category, with supply, acquisition and ops building out under you. Think of this seat as a venture builder inside Fleek.

 - Sell supply into live demand: onboard brands, brokers, graders and wholesalers, then get Fleek's existing buyers transacting on the new inventory. The sell is fast, informal and relationship-led, over WhatsApp and Instagram as often as in a boardroom.

 - Make the kill calls: hold a clear view of unit economics and the competitive landscape on every bet. Double down or cut on evidence, not attachment.

 - Be the ops function, for now: work out importer-of-record structures, duties, freight cost and last mile for each new flow.

 - Ride the AI infrastructure: our acquisition team has spent months building the agentic outreach and enrichment engine. You'll plug your bets into it and extend it, rather than building from a blank page or adding headcount.

 - Learn the actual trade: how stock is graded, routed and priced across markets, and who's sitting on good inventory that nobody has approached. You'll get deep in it fast.

 - AI fluency. You work with agents and automations daily and you'd rather build a workflow than repeat a task.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT CLIPBOARD

This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About the role:

An indispensable component of Clipboard's marketplace is its workplace customers. The Account Manager ensures the continued success of the partnership between Clipboard and its workplace partners, working to deliver an optimal experience at every level of their organizations. The job encompasses being a resource to workplaces when issues arise, liaising with building- and corporate-level contacts, and keeping abreast of a litany of important business metrics for each account. 

Your week will be balanced between high-touch customer engagement and internal account strategy, with a laser focus on net revenue retention. You are an avid problem-solver, a strategic communicator, and a diligent executor who can navigate complex relationships to sharpen your business acumen.

Responsibilities:

 - Manage & grow your portfolio: Own a book of business with accountability for "Same-Store Shift Postings" (SSSP, which measures utilization) and "Same-Store Net Revenue" (SSNR, which measures profitability). In your pursuit of driving those numbers higher, you will identify churn risks, mitigate issues, and proactively uncover opportunities for commercial expansion.

 - Strategic account planning: Build and maintain detailed account plans. Forecast performance accurately and provide regular insights to internal leadership regarding pipeline health and account stability.

 - Drive executive value: Establish trust with both clinical and non-clinical executives. Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and strategic meetings to demonstrate value, align on business goals, and negotiate mutually beneficial outcomes.

 - Operational excellence: Act as the primary point of contact for complex escalations, ensuring rapid resolution while implementing systemic solutions to prevent recurrence.

 - Cross-functional advocacy: Partner with Product, Legal, and Strategy Operations to represent the voice of the customer, driving product improvements and internal initiatives that optimize the client experience.

Beyond the basics, what will make you successful:

 - Extreme ownership: The buck stops with you, no matter what anyone else did or did not do. You're self-reliant, and can get things done in the chaos that is an early-stage startup scaling quickly.

 - Extreme curiosity: You ask "why" 3-5 times in a row for the same problem, digging and digging and not being satisfied until you truly understand the root cause.

 - Scrappiness: You look for ways through problems and refuse to let obstacles derail your progress. You bring solutions instead of asking ‘what should I do?’

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Location: Remote, US · 50% travel

ABOUT FLAI

AI has transformed B2B SaaS, but it has struggled to reach the real-world industries that shape our lives. Flai is building the leading AI-native service CRM for car dealerships.

Auto dealerships are a $1.3 trillion industry and sell 96% of the 16 million new cars sold each year. Yet they still run on outdated systems and manual processes, and they spend $36B a year on operations. That’s our opportunity.

Flai is live in many hundreds of dealerships across the U.S., including more than 20% of the top 50 dealer groups. We work closely with OEMs and distributors too, and Toyota Ventures is one of our largest investors. We’ve raised over $33M from leading VCs, including First Round Capital, Toyota Ventures, Y Combinator, Innovation Endeavors, SV Angel and Liquid 2.

We’ve grown very fast with a small, scrappy team, and we keep moving at that pace.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We’re hiring an Implementation Manager to own the moment a dealership goes from signed to live on Flai. You’ll be in stores more weeks than not. You’ll connect Flai to the DMS, configure our AI for how each service department actually runs, train advisors, techs, and BDC teams, and stand on the service drive on launch day. You’ll work directly with the founding team. Each launch you run will feed into how we roll out across hundreds of new rooftops and OEM programs.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own launches end to end: Run every go-live from kickoff to hand-off, across single rooftops and multi-store groups. You own the timeline, the integrations, the configuration, the training and launch day itself.

 - Be on-site when it matters: Travel to dealerships for go-lives, training and post-launch tune-ups. Get to know the service drive, the BDC and the people who run them.

 - Make the integrations work: Coordinate DMS and scheduler connections (Tekion, CDK, Reynolds, Dealertrack, Xtime, Dealer-FX, myKaarma and others), along with phone systems and data mapping. Troubleshoot alongside engineering until everything runs cleanly.

 - Configure Flai for each store: Turn each dealership’s hours, menus, op codes, routing rules and appointment workflow into a setup that works on day one.

 - Train for adoption, not attendance: Train service advisors, BDC agents, service managers and fixed ops directors until Flai is part of how they work every day.

 - Hit launch metrics: Own time-to-live, early adoption, and first-30-day results.

 - Hand off cleanly: Pass healthy, live accounts to Customer Success with clear notes, open items and a baseline of results.

 - Scale group and OEM rollouts: Plan and run phased rollouts across dealer groups and OEM-backed programs. Sequence stores, coordinate stakeholders and keep a dozen launches moving at once.

 - Sharpen the playbook: Follow Flai’s implementation process rigorously, and help improve it based on what you learn in each store.

 - Feed the product team: Bring back what you see in dealerships, such as integration gaps, workflow edge cases and recurring requests, so it shapes what we build next.

MUST HAVE

 - Dealer implementation experience: 3+ years launching software in dealerships, ideally service-side: schedulers, DMS, or service lane tools.

 - Fixed ops fluency: You know how a service department runs, from the appointment to the write-up to the RO, and you can speak advisors’ language. Dealership experience is a big plus.

 - Willing to travel: You’re comfortable traveling >50% of the time, often on short notice, to dealerships across the U.S.

 - Technical comfort: You’re at ease with integrations, data mapping, configuration and troubleshooting, and you can work productively with engineers.

 - Project discipline: You keep timelines tight, track every open item and manage several launches at once without anything slipping.

 - Strong trainer and communicator: You can command a room of advisors at 7am, run a clean kickoff with a GM, and write follow-ups people actually read.

 - High ownership: A launch isn’t done until the store is using Flai and seeing results. You stay on it until then.

 - Excited to be early: You want to help build something at its earliest stage and are energized by a process that’s still evolving.

WHY FLAI

This is about as early as it gets. We have real traction, customers who love the product, and investors who’ve backed some of the best companies in the world betting big on us. You’ll be part of one of the most exciting build-outs in AI right now, in an industry that’s about to look completely different because of what we’re building. The launches you run over the next 12 months will set the standard for how Flai goes live in every store after them. We move fast and we have fun doing it. Come be part of the story while it’s still being written.

WHAT WE OFFER

 - $80k-130k OTE depending on experience

 - Equity

 - Travel expenses covered

 - Full benefits including medical, dental and vision

 - Flexible PTO

 - A small, high-trust, fast-moving team that has a good time building something real

jobs.title: Deal Strategist
jobs.description:
ABOUT CAMPFIRE

Campfire is building modern accounting software for startups and mid-size tech companies, and we're going head to head with giants like NetSuite to do it. Our AI-native general ledger runs the close, revenue recognition, and reporting for finance teams that have outgrown QuickBooks and refuse to settle for a legacy ERP.

THE ROLE

You'll own how Campfire makes money on every deal. Pricing strategy, deal structuring, partner economics, and the systems that make it all repeatable. You'll model a deal like you're underwriting it, then write the code that makes the next hundred deals faster.

You'll work directly with sales leadership, legal, finance, and business operations, and you'll have real authority to say yes, no, and "here's a better structure."

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Crack the hard deals. Structure and approve non-standard deals: multi-year ramps, discounts, buyouts, swaps, implementation fees, and payment terms. Turn messy asks from AEs into clean, defensible structures fast.

 - Own pricing strategy. Build and evolve our packaging and price book. Move us toward value-based pricing grounded in the outcomes customers actually get.

 - Price what we ship next. Own unit economics for each product, and build the business case and pricing for new products and AI features before they launch.

 - Write the rules. Own the discount and approval policy: who can approve what, which exceptions escalate, and the playbook that lets AEs move fast without giving away margin.

 - Price partnerships. Model the economics of channel and platform deals, like fund administrators running their clients on Campfire, and make sure we capture our share of the value we create.

 - Underwrite every deal. Build models for margin, payback, LTV, and the downstream impact on ARR, bookings, and quota credit. Know which deals to fight for and which to walk from.

 - Build the machine. Build the systems and automations that power quoting, approvals, and deal analytics across our CRM and our internal tools. If it's manual twice, you automate it.

 - Be the commercial brain in the room. Partner with sales on contract terms and live negotiations.

WHO YOU ARE

We care more about trajectory than pedigree. If you've built impressive things from an unusual starting point, we want to hear from you.

 - Investor-trained. 2-4 years in investment banking, management consulting, private equity, strategic finance, or a related finance function, with experience at a high-growth technology company a plus. You think in returns, downside cases, and term sheets.

 - AI-native in how you work. You already use tools like Claude Code to build models, automate analysis, and get more done than a team twice your size. You're comfortable building and have shipped something real: a model, a pipeline, a tool people used.

 - Intellectually sharp. You find the flaw in a structure before anyone else does, and you can explain it in one sentence.

 - A clear communicator. You can walk leadership or the board through a complex deal or pricing change and leave them with a decision, not a spreadsheet.

 - Extreme ownership. You treat Campfire's revenue like your own money. You're the person who stays on the deal until it's right, and who people trust with the hardest calls.

 - Fast and decisive. You'd rather make a good call today than a perfect one next week, and you own the outcome either way.

 - Precise. Fast doesn’t mean sloppy. Pricing mistakes compound across every renewal, so you check the math and get the details right.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook yet. You'll write it.

WHY THIS ROLE

 - Direct line to leadership. You work with leadership on decisions that move the business.

 - Real leverage. Your code and your judgment compound across every deal we sign.

jobs.title: Research Fellow
jobs.description:
ABOUT ABUNDANT

AI models rely on two fundamental ingredients: compute and data. Abundant is building the NVIDIA of training data. NVIDIA, the leader in compute, has a peak market cap of $5T and generated $130B in revenue last year as the need for scaling compute has exploded. We believe the need to scale data is just beginning, as we move beyond SFT and human supervision to RL and Learning from Experience.

 

Our founding team consists of former founders, ML engineers, roboticists and data leads from Waymo, Google, Mercor and AWS. Our team has previously worked with DeepMind to deploy deep learning models at 1B user scale, trained SOTA models for self-driving at Waymo, and scaled data pipelines of tens of thousands of human annotators at YouTube. Our pioneering work in human computation, synthetic data, simulation and RL give us the advantage in delivering results to our customers.

 

Why now? Training data is more important and more scarce than ever before. Scaling laws dictate that linear improvement in model performance demands an exponential increase in training data. But there is only one World Wide Web and most of it has already been trained on. The next advances will require major advances in simulation, synthetic data and learning from experience.

 

What happens if we succeed? Abundant will be the core enabler for not only AGI, but ASI and physical intelligence. Most of the challenges in model algorithms and compute are already solved. What’s missing? The data necessary to move from general knowledge to domain expertise; from chatbots to agents; and from text to multimodal and physical AI. Ask any AI researcher or roboticist: the core bottleneck to progress is the availability of data, hence “abundant data”.

 

Abundant works with a majority of the top AI labs, as well as frontier startups and F500 enterprises.

 

THE ROLE

As a Research Intern you will work directly with Abundant's founding team to architect the next generation of model reasoning and intelligence. Over the course of 12 weeks, you will be paired with a mentor who will work with you on your proposal. Your fellowship will culminate in submitting your research to a major conference for review. You should be able to commit at least 20 hours a week to this program.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Drive Foundational Research & Execution: Architect and execute a core research agenda to discover simple, generalizable ideas that advance model reasoning and intelligence at scale. This includes owning the full research-to-production lifecycle and ensuring rapid deployment of your work in live systems.

 - Build life-long friendships: Meet other researchers who share your interests, both within the program and at our weekly meetups exclusively for Abundant Fellows.

 - Model Alignment & Data Strategy: Partner with the world's most advanced AI research teams to design, engineer, and iterate on high-impact datasets and large-scale benchmarking efforts that shape how frontier models behave, specifically focusing on critical alignment, safety, and defining optimal reward signals.

 - Autonomous Problem Selection: Autonomously identify, scope, and manage long-running research projects, choosing the most impactful problems that are critical to scaling data for AGI/ASI.

 - System Infrastructure: Collaborate closely with engineering teams on data pipelines, internal tooling, and high-performance deep learning algorithm implementations.

WHO YOU ARE

 - Exceptional Research Depth & Strategic Vision: Research expertise in a related field (e.g., CS, ML, NLP) ideally with that work published at a major conference (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR). You must possess the velocity to master complex fields and a proven track record in the productization of research, encompassing high-stakes evaluation, large-scale benchmarking, and product feature development.
 
 - Proven experience shipping research directly to production and live systems, specifically focusing on advanced post-training, distillation, and high-stakes evaluation methodologies.
 
 - Large-scale agent systems: orchestration frameworks, tool APIs, distributed execution, observability, and logging infrastructure.

 - Strategic & Ethical Leadership: You possess a thoughtful, strategic perspective on the societal and safety impacts of deploying general-purpose AI systems. Experience advising on or shaping governmental policy related to AI safety and governance (e.g., House of Lords or Online Safety Bill initiatives) is required.
 
 

COMPENSATION

Base Salary

$7500/month
